Na ɛyɛɛ hare maa no sɛ ɔbɛnante Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne mu, na ɔkɔfaa Sidonfoɔ hene Etbaal babaa Isebel waree, na ɔkɔ kɔsomm Baal na ɔsɔree no.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa Baal wɔ
Na Ahab yɛɛ Asera nnua na
Ne berɛ so na Betelni Hiel kyekyeree Yeriko N’abakan Abiram wui
Na Tisbini Elia a ɔfiri Gilead atubrafoɔ mu ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn
Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: 2
Firi ha kɔ na dane wo ho
Na wobɛnom asuo no mu nsuo, na mahyɛ anene sɛ wɔnhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ. 4
Na ɔsii mu kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ, na ɔkɔ kɔtenaa asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan apueeɛ no ho. 5
Na anene brɛɛ no paanoo ne nam anɔpa
Na ɛbaa sɛ nna bi akyiri no asuo
Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: 8
Sɔre kɔ Sarefat a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ deɛ no na kɔtena hɔ
Na ɔsɔre kɔɔ Sarefat.
Na ɔrekɔ akɔsa no ɔka kyerɛɛ

Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te aseɛ yi, atodeɛ biara nni me nsam, gye esiam nsa ma a ɛwɔ kuruwa mu, ne ngo kakra a ɛwɔ toa mu, na hwɛ, merepɛ mmaboa mmienu bi makɔ makɔto, na me ne me ba adi na yɛawu.
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Nsuro kɔyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka
Na sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie Esiam kuruwa no so renhwan na ngo toa
Na ɔkɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Elia ka kyerɛɛ no
na esiam kuruwa no so anhwan,
Na nsɛm yi akyiri no ɔbaa fiewura
Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn nipa, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Wobaa me nkyɛn sɛ worebɛma wɔakae me bɔne na wɔakum me ba!
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa wo ba no brɛ me!
Na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ
Na ɔtenee ne mu butuu abɔfra no so mprɛnsa na ɔteaa
Na AWURADE tiee Elia nne, na abɔfra no kra sane baa ne mu, na ɔnyaa nkwa. 22
Na Elia faa abɔfra no de
Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ Afei na mahunu
Na nna pii akyiri no afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu
Na Elia sii mu kɔɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho rekɔkyerɛ Ahab. Nso na ɛkɔm a emu yɛ den aba Samaria. 2
Na Ahab frɛɛ Obadia a ɔdi ne fie soɔ; (nso Obadia deɛ, na ɔsuro AWURADE sɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ Isebel retwitwa AWURADE adiyifoɔ aguo no Obadia faa
Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Obadia sɛ Kɔkyini asase no so nsuo aniwa nyinaa ne nsubɔnhwa
Na wɔkyɛɛ asase no mu fae sɛ wɔrekyini so, Ahab nko faa ɔkwan baako so, na Obadia nko nso faa ɔkwan baako soɔ.6
Na Obadia wɔ ɔkwan no soɔ
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Menie. Kɔka kyerɛ wo wura sɛ: Mahunu Elia. 8
Na ɔkaa sɛ Bɔne bɛn na mayɛ
Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te aseɛ yi ɔman ne ahennie biara nni hɔ a me wura nsoma mmaa wɔnkɔɔ
Na afei wo ara wose Kɔka kyerɛ
Na sɛ me deɛ mefiri wo nkyɛn mekɔ a AWURADE honhom bɛma
Wɔnkaa deɛ Isebel kumm AWURADE adiyifoɔ no meyɛeɛ
Na afei wo deɛ wose Kɔka kyerɛ
Na Elia kaa sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, ɛyɛ dɛn ara a nnɛ mede me ho bɛkyerɛ no.
Ɛnna Obadia kɔ kɔhyiaa Ahab, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no; na Ahab kɔ kɔhyiaa Elia.16
Na Ahab hunuu Elia no
Na ɔse: Menhaa Israel, na mmom wo ne w’agya fie, sɛ moagya AWURADE mmara nsɛm, na moakɔdi Baalim akyire.
Na afei soma ma wɔnkɔboaboa Israel nyinaa ano mmrɛ me Karmel bepɔ so ne Baal adiyifoɔ ahanan aduonum no ne Asera adiyifoɔ ahanan a wɔdidi Isebel pono soɔ no.
Na Ahab soma maa wɔkɔɔ Israelfoɔ nyinaa mu kɔboaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano kɔɔ Karmel bepɔ so.20
Ɛnna Elia twe pinii ɔman no nyinaa nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mo adwene bɛyɛ
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Me deɛ, me nko ara mene AWURADE diyifoɔ a waka, na Baal adiyifoɔ deɛ, wɔyɛ mmarima ahanan aduonum. 22
Na momma wɔmma yɛn anantwinini mmienu na ma wɔnyi nantwinini no baako mfa
Na mommɔ mo nyame din na me nso memmɔ AWURADE
Ɛnna Elia ka kyerɛɛ Baal adiyifoɔ no sɛ Monyi nantwinini baako mfa na monsiesie
Na wɔfaa nantwinini a wɔde maa wɔn no na wɔsiesiee
Na ɛduruu awigyina no Elia sii wɔn atwetweɛ goroo
Na wɔde nne kɛseɛ teateaa mu na
Na awigyina twaa mu no, wɔkɔmee kɔsii sɛ ɛrekɔ aduane afɔrebɔ berɛ soɔ; nso wɔante nne biara, na obiara nso annye so, na obiara nso antie wɔn.29
Ɛnna Elia ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ Montwe mpini me! Na
Na Elia tasee aboɔ dummienu sɛ Yakob a AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Israel ne wo din no, mma mmusuakuo no ano sie.
Na ɔde aboɔ no sii afɔrebukyia, AWURADE din mu, na ɔtwaa ɛka a ɛbɛdi aba a wɔguo susuo adeɛ mmienu afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae. 32
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ nnyina no na ɔtwitwaa nantwinini
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Monyɛ bio!
Na nsuo no fefaa afɔrebukyia
Na afɔrebɔberɛ mu no Odiyifoɔ Elia twe pinii na ɔkaa sɛ AWURADE Abraham ne Isak
Gye me so AWURADE gye
Ɛnna AWURADE gya duru bɛhyee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ne nnyina
Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuiɛ
Na Elia kaa sɛ: Monkyere Baal adiyifoɔ no, mommma wɔn mu biara mmfiri mu mfi!
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Foro kɔ kɔdidi na nom.
Na Ahab foro kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔdidi na wanom.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra sɛ: Foro kɔ kɔhwɛ po fam.
Na ɛbaa sɛ deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no ɔkaa
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɛyɛɛ kakra na mununkum ne mframa abiri soro tumm, na osu kɛseɛ bi tɔe.
Na AWURADE nsa baa Elia so, na ɔbɔɔ n’abɔsoɔ tuu mmirika dii Ahab anim de kɔduruu sɛ wɔrehyɛne Yesreel.46
Na Ahab bɛka kyerɛɛ Isebel deɛ Elia yɛeɛ no nyinaa ne sɛdeɛ ɔkumm adiyifoɔ no nyinaa, nkrantɛ ano no.
Na Isebel somaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no kɔɔ Elia nkyɛn sɛ Sei na anyame
Na ɔhunuu saa no ne nkwa nti ɔsuroe na ɔsɔre kɔe
Na ɔno deɛ, ɔnantee ɛserɛ so da koro kwan na ɔkɔtenaa sesea bi ase, na ɔsrɛ maa ne ho sɛ anka ɔnwu.
Na ɔde ne ho too hɔ sesea bi ase.
Na ɔhwɛe na hwɛ
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ sane bɛkaa no ne mprenu soɔ sɛ: Sɔre didi, na ɔkwan no ware papa ma wo. 7
Na ɔsɔre didii na ɔnomee
Na ɔduruu ɔbodan no ho hɔ, na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
Na ɔse Ninkunu na matwe mama AWURADE asafo Nyankopɔn sɛ Israelfoɔ agya w’apam w’afɔrebukyia no wɔadwiridwiri
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Firi adi kɔgyina bepɔ no so AWURADE anim.
na asasewosoɔ no akyiri no, ogya,
Na ɛbaa sɛ Elia teeɛ no, ɔde ne ngusoɔ kataa n’anim, na ɔfiri kɔgyinaa ɔbodan no ano.
Na ɔse Ninkunu na matwe mama AWURADE asafo Nyankopɔn sɛ Israelfoɔ agya w’apam W’afɔrebukyia no wɔadwiridwiri
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ, sane si wo kwan so kɔ Damasko serɛ so; na sɛ woduru a, sra Hasael ngo si no Siria so hene;
na Nimsi ba Yehu nso, sra no ngo si Israel so hene;
Na deɛ ɔbɛfiri Hasael nkrantɛ ano no Yehu bɛku
Nanso mɛgya Israel mu nnipa mpemnson, nkotodwe a ɛnnya nkutoo Baal, ne ano a ɛnnya mfee n’ano.18
Ɛnna ɔfirii hɔ kɔeɛ Na ɔkɔhunuu Safat ba Elisa sɛ ɔrefuntum anantwie mpamho dummienu na ɛdi n’anim
Na ɔgyaa anantwie no hɔ, na ɔtuu mmirika dii Elia akyi kaa sɛ: Ma menkɔ kra m’agya ne me na, na memmɛdi w’akyi.
Na ɔsane firii n’akyi kɔfaa anantwie mpamho no kumm wɔn na ɔde
Afei Dawid nna bɛnee sɛ ɔbɛwuo no, ɔhyɛɛ ne ba Salomo sɛ: 1
Me deɛ, mereti nananom wɔ asamando: Enti yɛ den na yɛ ɔbarima; 2
na hwɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ sɛ wobɛ
Na AWURADE ama n’asɛm a ɔkaa no me ho
Bio wo ara wonim deɛ Seruia ba Yoab yɛɛ me
Enti di no nyansa so, na mma ne dwono mmfa asomdwoeɛ mu nnsiane nnkɔ Asamando.
Na Gileadni Barsilai mma deɛ, yɛ wɔn adɔeɛ na ma wɔntena wɔn a wɔdidi wo pono soɔ mu;
Na hwɛ Benyaminni Gera ba Simei a ɔfiri Bahurim
Na afei deɛ mma ne ho nnyɛ no tɔtorɔtɔɔ na woyɛ ɔba nyansafoɔ
Ɛnna Dawid tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu.
Na nna a Dawid de dii Israel so hene yɛ mfirinhyia aduanan Ɔdii
Na Salomo tenaa n’agya adwa so, na n’ahennie tim pintinn pa.12
Na Hagit ba Adoniya baa Salomo na Batseba nkyɛn.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Mewɔ asɛm bi meka kyerɛ wo.
Na ɔkaa sɛ Wo ara wonim
Na afei adeɛ baako pɛ na merebisa no wo hɔ, na nkame me.
Na ɔse: Mesrɛ wo, ka kyerɛ Ɔhene Salomo, na ɔrenkame wo, na ɔmfa Sunamni Abisag mma me aware.
Na Batseba kaa sɛ: Yoo, mɛka makyerɛ ɔhene mama wo.18
Ɛnna Batseba baa Ɔhene Salomo nkyɛn sɛ ɔde Adoniya dwantoa rebrɛ no Na ɔhene sɔre kɔhyiaa
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ade ketewa bi na merebɛbisa no wo hɔ, na nkame me.
Na ɔse: Ma wɔmfa Sunamni Abisag mma wo nua Adoniya awareɛ. 21
Na Ɔhene Salomo bua see ne na sɛ:
Ɛnna Ɔhene Salomo kaa AWURADE ntam sɛ: Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sei na ɔnkɔ so saa, sɛ Adoniya asɛm a waka yi nti wɔakum no a. 23
Na afei sɛ AWURADE a wama matim na ɔde me atena m’agya Dawid adwa soɔ
Na Ɔhene Salomo somaa Yoiada ba Benaia maa no kɔkumm no.25
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar nso, ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ Anatot, wo ara w’asase so, na woyɛ owuo ba.
Saa na Salomo tuu Abiatar sɛ ɔnnni AWURADE sɔfoɔ bio
Na asɛm no duruu Yoab nkyɛn na
Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Salomo sɛ: Yoab adwane kɔ AWURADE ntomadan mu, na hwɛ, wakɔsɔ afɔrebukyia no ho mmɛn no mu.
Na Benaia kɔɔ AWURADE ntomadan no mu kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Firi adi!
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Yɛ sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ
Na AWURADE mma ne mogya mmua n’atifi sɛ ɔkumm mmarima baanu a wɔtene
Na wɔn mogya nsane mmɛbua Yoab atifi ne n’asefoɔ
Na Yoiada ba Benaia foro kɔkumm no; na wɔsiee no ne fie wɔ ɛserɛ so. 34
Na ɔhene de Yoiada ba Benaia sii n’ananmu dii ɛdɔm no so, na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok nso, ɔhene de no sii Abiatar ananmu.35
Na ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Simei bae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Si dan wɔ Yerusalem fa, na tena hɔ, na mfiri hɔ nkɔ baabiara, 36
na da a wobɛfiri adie akɔtwa Kidron subonhwa no, hunu sɛ, wuo
Na Simei ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ɛyɛ; sɛdeɛ me wura ɔhene aka no, saa ara na w’akoa bɛyɛ.
Na mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyiri no, Simei nkoa baanu dwane kɔɔ Gathene Maaka ba Akis nkyɛn.
Na Simei sɔre hyehyɛɛ n’afunumupɔnkɔ, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Gat, Akis nkyɛn sɛ ɔrekɔhwehwɛ ne nkoa no; na Simei kɔ kɔfaa ne nkoa no firii Gat bae. 40
Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Salomo sɛ: Simei afiri Yerusalem akɔ Gat, na wasane aba. 41
Na ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔfaa Simei bae sɛ Manka wo AWURADE ntam manni
Adɛn nti na woanni AWURADE ntam ne mmara a mehyɛɛ woɔ no soɔ? 43
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: Wo ara wonim, w’akomam, bɔne a wode yɛɛ m’agya Dawid no nyinaa, na AWURADE adane wo bɔne no agu w’atifi.
Na nhyira bɛka Ɔhene Salomo, na Dawid adwa bɛtim AWURADE anim akɔsi daa. 45
Na ɔhene hyɛɛ Yoiada ba Benaia, na ɔfirii adi kɔkumm no.46
Na ahennie no tim Salomo nsam.

Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔbaa Israelhene Ahab nkyɛn kuro no mu bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ Ben-hadad seɛ nie: 2
Wo dwetɛ ne wo sika yɛ me dea na
Na Israel hene buaa sɛ: W’asɛm no wom, me wura ɔhene, wo na me ne deɛ mewɔ nyinaa wɔ woɔ. 4

Na Ben-hadad soma kɔsee no sɛ Mede mmarima bebree bɛba abɛsɛe wo kuro
Na Israel hene buaa sɛ Monkɔka
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔtee asɛm yi no na ɔne ahemfo
Na hwɛ, odiyifoɔ bi twe pinii Israelhene Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Wohunu asafokuo kɛseɛ yi nyinaa? Hwɛ, mede wɔn merehyɛ wo nsa nnɛ, na woahunu sɛ mene AWURADE. 13
Na Ahab kaa sɛ: Ɛnam hwan so?
Ɛnna ɔkan amansini mmapɔmma no mmeranteɛ
Na wɔfirii adi awigyina.

Na ɔse Sɛ ɔmannwoeɛ so na wɔfirii adie a monkye wɔn animono
Na wɔn deɛ wɔfiri kuro no mu firii adi amansini mmapɔmma
Na wɔkumm wɔn mmaako
Na Israel hene firii adi kɔ kyekyeree apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam, na ɔde okunkɛseɛ kumm Siriafoɔ.21
Na odiyifoɔ no twe pinii Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ
Na Siriahene nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Wɔn nyame yɛ mmepɔ
Na yei na yɛ: Tutu ahemfo no firi wɔn dibea, na fa amradofoɔ sisi wɔn ananmu. 24
Na wo deɛ boaboa ɛdɔm bi ano sɛ
Na afeda ɔpɛ berɛ mfitiaseɛ no mu, Ben-hadad boaboaa Siriafoɔ dɔm ano na ɔforo baa Afek sɛ ɔne Israel rebɛko. 26
Na wɔboaboaa Israelfoɔ nso ano, na wɔsiesiee wɔn ho, na wɔkɔ kɔhyiaa wɔn.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no twe pinii bɛka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ Sɛdeɛ AWURADE seɛ nie Ɛsiane
Na wɔkyeree nsraban, yeinom wɔ yeinom ntentensoɔ, nnanson.
Na nkaeɛ no dwanedwane kɔɔ Afek kuro
Na Ben-hadad deɛ, ɔdwane kɔɔ kuro no mu firi pia mu kɔɔ pia mu.
Na ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Hwɛ yɛate
Na wɔde ayitoma kyekyeree wɔn asene na
Afei na mmarima no rehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anim kwan
Na Ben-hadad ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Nkuro a m’agya gyee
Ɛnna ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri adiyifoɔ mma mu de AWURADE asɛm ka kyerɛɛ ne yɔnko sɛ: Bɔ me ɛ! Na ɔbarima no ampene sɛ ɔbɔ no. 35
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Ɛsiane
Na ɔhunuu ɔbarima foforɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bɔ me ɛ!
Ɛnna odiyifoɔ no kɔ kɔgyinaa ɔkwan
Na ɔhene retwam no ɔbɔnee
Na w’akoa reyɛ adeɛ foforɔ no, hwɛ, ɔdwanneeɛ hɔ. Ɛnna Israel hene kaa sɛ: Sɛ w’atemmuo teɛ ne no, wo ara woabu. 40
Ɛnna ɔyɛɛ ntɛm yii abotire no firii n’ani akyire, na Israel hene no hunuu no sɛ ɔfiri adiyifoɔ no mu. 41
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie Ɛsiane
Ɛnna Israel hene no sii mu kɔɔ ne fie, a wakum n’anim na ne bo afuo, na ɔbaa Samaria.43

Ɛnna Atalia tee ɔman a wɔretu mmirika na wɔreyi ɔhene ayɛ no gyegyeegye no, ɔbaa nkurɔfoɔ no nkyɛn AWURADE fie, 12
na ɔbɛhunui,
Na Yehoiada yii ɔha ha so asafohene a wɔhwɛ dɔm no soɔ
Na wɔsɔɔ ne mu de no kɔɔ apɔnkɔ pono ano, ahemfie, na wɔkumm no wɔ hɔ.15
Ɛnna Yehoiada de apam too ɔno ne ɔman no nyinaa ne ɔhene no ntam sɛ wɔnyɛ AWURADE man.
Na ɔman no nyinaa kɔɔ Baal fie kɔdwirii gui na n’afɔrebukyia ne n’ahoni
Na Yehoiada siesiee AWURADE fie hwɛ nnwuma no de hyɛɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔne Lewifoɔ
Nanso ɔde apono ano ahwɛfoɔ gyinagyinaa AWURADE fie
Na ɔfaa ɔha ha so asafohene no ne aberempɔn
Na asase no sofoɔ nyinaa ani gyee, na kuro no mu dwoe.
Yoas dii mfeɛ nson na ɔbɛdii hene
Na Yoas yɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada berɛ no so nyinaa. 2
Na Yehoiada waree yerenom baanu maa no, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.3
Na ɛno akyiri no ɛbaa Yoas akoma mu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ. 4
Na ɔboaboaa asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ
Ɛnna ɔhene no frɛɛ Ɔpanin Yehoiada na ɔka kyerɛɛ
Na Atalia ɔbɔnefoɔ no mma ahyɛne Nyankopɔn fie
Na ɔhene no ka maa wɔpamm adaka baako, na wɔde sii AWURADE fie pono ano wɔ adihɔ, 8
na wɔpaee no Yuda ne Yerusalem sɛ wɔmfa Nyankopɔn akoa Mose toɔ a ɔde too Israel so wɔ ɛserɛ so no mmrɛ AWURADE.
Na mmapɔmma no nyinaa ne ɔman no nyinaa ani gyee.
Na berɛ biara a Lewifoɔ no bɛhunu sɛ sika adɔɔso wɔ adaka
Na ɔhene ne Yehoiada de maa wɔn a wɔyɛ AWURADE fie som adwuma no na wɔde bobɔɔ aboɔpaefoɔ
Na wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no yɛe na pempam
Na wɔwieeɛ no wɔde sika
Na Yehoiada bɔɔ akora, na wanyini pa ara no, ɔwui.
Na wɔkɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu ahemfo
Na Yehoiada wuo akyiri no, Yuda mmapɔmma ba bɛkotoo ɔhene no. Ɛnna ɔhene no tiee wɔn. 17
Na wɔgyaa AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn fie, na wɔkɔsomm Asera nnua ne ahoni no.
Na ɔsomaa adiyifoɔ maa wɔbaa wɔn mu sɛ wɔmmɛsane
Na Nyankopɔn honhom baa Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada ba Sakaria so, na ɔkɔgyinaa soro ɔman no anim ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ Onyankopɔn seɛ nie: Adɛn nti na moto AWURADE mmara nsɛm?
Na wɔpam ne tiri so, na wɔkɔsii no aboɔ, sɛdeɛ ɔhene hyɛeɛ no AWURADE fie abannwa so.
Na Ɔhene Yoas ankae adɔeɛ a Sakaria agya Yehoiada de yɛɛ no no, na ɔkumm ne ba no.
Na afe no awieeɛ
Na nnipa kakraa bi na Siriafoɔ dɔm de baeɛ nanso AWURADE
Na wɔfirii ne so sii mu kɔeɛ na wɔgyaa no apirakuro bebree
Na wɔn a wɔpamm ne tiri soɔ no nie: Sabad, Amonni baa Simeat ba ne Yehosabad, Moabni baa Simrit ba. 26
Na ne mma no
Amasia dii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, nanso ɛnyɛ n’akoma pɛyɛ mu. 2
Na ɛbaa sɛ ahennie no timm ne nsam pɛ, ɔkunkumm ne nkoa a wɔkumm n’agya, ɔhene no.
Na wɔn mma deɛ wankum
Na Amasia boaboaa Yuda ano hyiae na wɔde wɔn gyinagyinae mpanimfie so ne mpem
Nanso ɔde dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha kɔbɔɔ Israel mu nnipa mpemha a wɔyɛ mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho pa ara. 6
Na Nyankopɔn nipa bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Ɔhene, mma Israel dɔm no ne wo nnkɔ, na AWURADE nni Israel, Efraim mma no nyinaa akyi; 7
nanso sɛ wosusu
Ɛnna Amasia bisaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Na ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha a mede ama Israel asafo no? Na Nyankopɔn nipa no se: Ɛwɔ AWURADE nsam sɛ ɔbɛma wo adeɛ pii asene yei. 9
Na Amasia paee no asafo a wɔfiri Efraim baa ne nkyɛn
Na Amasia hyɛɛ ne ho den na ɔde
Na wɔn mu nnipa mpemdu nso Yudafoɔ no faa
Na asafo a Amasia maa wɔsanee sɛ wɔne no nnkɔ ɔsa
Na Amasia firii Edomfoɔ kum sane baeɛ no ɔde Seirfoɔ anyame bae na
Ɛnna AWURADE abufuo sɔre tiaa Amasia, na ɔsomaa odiyifoɔ bi baa ne nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woahwehwɛ ɔman bi anyame a wɔantumi annye wɔn man amfiri wo nsam no? 15
Na ɔrekasa akyerɛ no
Ɛnna Yudahene Amasia tuu agyina, na ɔsomaa Israelhene Yoas a ɔyɛ Yehoahas ba Yehu baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Bra ma yɛnsɔ yɛn ho nhwɛ. 17
Na Israelhene Yoas soma maa wɔkɔɔ Yudahene Amasia nkyɛn sɛ Nkasɛɛ dua a ɛwɔ Lebanon no
Wose Hwɛ woakum Edom na w’ahoahoa wo ho sɛ worehwehwɛ animuonyam Afei tena
Na Amasia antie ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn nsam na ɛfire
Na Israelhene Yoas foro bae, na wɔde bɛbɔɔ anim, ɔno ne Yudahene Amasia wɔ Bet-semes a ɛyɛ Yuda dea no. 21
Na Yuda gui wɔ Israel anim, na wɔdwanedwane kɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu. 22
Na Yudahene Amasia a ɔyɛ Yoas ba Yehoahas
Na ɔfaa sika ne dwetɛ nyinaa
Na Yudahene Amasia a ɔyɛ Yoas ba dii mfirinhyia dunum, Israelhene Yoas a ɔyɛ Yehoahas ba no wuo akyi. 25
Na Amasia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ akane deɛ ne akyire yi
Na ɛfiri berɛ a Amasia sane firii AWURADE akyire no, wɔpamm ne tiri so wɔ Yerusalem, na ɔdwane kɔɔ Lakis, na wɔsoma maa wɔtii no kɔɔ Lakis kɔkumm no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔsoaa no apɔnkɔ so bae na wɔbɛsiee
Na Yuda man no nyinaa faa Usia, na wadi mfirinhyia dunsia, na wɔsii no hene n’agya Amasia ananmu.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elot
Usia dii mfeɛ dunsia na ɔbɛdii hene
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Amasia yɛeɛ no ara.
Na ɔhwehwɛɛ Onyankopɔn nna a Sakaria
Na ɔfirii adi ne Filistifoɔ kɔkoe na ɔbubuu Gat fasuo
Na Onyankopɔn boaa no tiaa Filistifoɔ ne Arabfoɔ a na wɔtete Gur-baal, ne Meunifoɔ no. 7
Na Amonfoɔ de apeatoɔ brɛɛ Usia, na ne din hyeta kɔduruu Misraim, na ne ho yɛɛ den kɔɔ so pa ara. 8
Na Usia totoo aban atentene wɔ Yerusalem ntweaso pono no so ne bonhwa
Na ɔtotoo aban atentene nso ɛserɛ so na ɔtutuu mmura pii ɛfiri sɛ
Na Usia wɔ dɔm a wɔdi ako
Agyanom atitire a wɔwɔ mmarima akofoɔ no mu no nyinaa ano si mpennu ahansia. 12
Na ɛdɔm a ɛhyɛ wɔn aseɛ
Wɔn na Usia siesiee akyɛm, mpea, nnadeɛkyɛ, nkataboɔ, ntadua ne ntɔmmoɔ maa wɔn, sɛ wɔmfa mma dɔm no nyinaa. 14
Na ɔyɛɛ adetoɔ mfidie a ɛyɛ adwumfoɔ adwini wɔ Yerusalem, sɛ ɛnsisi aban atentene so ne afasuo ntweaso, na wɔmfa ntoto agyan ne aboɔ akɛseɛ.
Na ne ho yɛɛ den no ɔyɛɛ ahantan na ɔbɔɔ brafunu
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria dii n’akyi, na AWURADE asɔfoɔ aduɔwɔtwe, nnipa a wɔtumi wɔn ho ka ne ho. 17
Na wɔkɔgyinae ne Ɔhene Usia dii asie na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ
Na Usia bo fui, na aduhwamhyeɛ adeɛ no kura ne nsam sɛ ɔde rebɛhye aduhwam no.
Na Ɔsɔfopanin Asaria danee n’ani kyerɛɛ no ɔne asɔfoɔ
Na Ɔhene Usia yaree kwata kɔsii ne wuda, na ɔtenaa ayarefoɔ fie sɛ ɔkwatani, na wɔsii no AWURADE fie kwan.
Na Usia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, akane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ no, Amos ba Odiyifoɔ Yesaia atwerɛ.
Na Usia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando na wɔsiee no
Yotam dii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Usia yɛeɛ no ara.
Ɔno na ɔsii AWURADE fie atifi pono no. Na Ofel fasuo no nso, ɔtoo bebree. 3
Na ɔkyekyeree nkuro nso wɔ Yuda mmepɔ so, na ɔtotoo aban a ɛyɛ den ne aban atentene kwaeɛ mu.
Na ɔno ara na ɔne Amonfoɔ hene kɔkoeɛ, na ɔdii wɔn so tumi.
Na Yotam yɛɛ ɔberempɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ɔsiesiee n’akwan AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn anim. 6
Na Yotam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne n’akodie
Ɔdii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene
Na Yotam tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro no mu.
Ahas dii mfeɛ aduonu na ɔbɛdii hene
Na ɔnantee Israel ahemfo akwan so, na ɔyɛɛ guo ahoni nso maa Baalim. 2
Na ɔhyee aduhwam Hinom ba bonhwa no mu na
Na ɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ na ɔhyee nnuhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea ne nkokoɔ so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase.4
Ɛnna AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn de no hyɛɛ Siriahene nsa na wɔkaa
Na Remalia ba Peka kunkumm Yuda mu nnipa mpemha aduonu da koro, mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho ara nko, ɛnam sɛ wɔagya AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn ntira. 6
Na Sikri, Efraim dɔmmarima bi, kumm ɔhene ba Maaseia ne ahemfie bapɔmma Asrikam ne Elkana a ɔdi ɔhene akyire.7
Na Israelfoɔ no faa wɔn nuanom mu nnipa mpemahanu nnommum, mmaa, mmammarima ne mmammaa, na wɔfomm wɔn asadeɛ bebree fae, na wɔde asadeɛ no kɔɔ Samaria.8
Na AWURADE diyifoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ne din de Oded Ɔno na ɔfirii adi kɔhyiaa dɔm
Na afei Yuda ne Yerusalem mma no na mose moredi wɔn nya ayɛ nkoa
Na afei, montie me, na momma nnommum a mofaa wɔn firii mo nuanom mu no nsane nkɔ, na AWURADE abufuhyeɛ asɔre atia mo. 11
Ɛnna Efraimfoɔ atitire mu binom Yohanan ba Asaria Mesilemot
na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ Mommfa nnommum no mma ha ɛfiri
Ɛnna wɔn a wɔamia no gyaa nnommum
Na mmarima a wɔabobɔ wɔn din no sɔresɔree na wɔsosɔɔ nnommum
Ɛberɛ no mu, Ɔhene Ahas soma maa wɔkɔɔ Asiria hene nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɛboa no. 16
Ɛfiri sɛ na Edomfoɔ no aba abɛkunkum Yudafoɔ bi na wɔafa binom nnommum. 17
Na Filistifoɔ nso abɛgu mpaperɛ so ne Yuda anafoɔ fam nkuro
Na ɛsiane sɛ Israelhene Ahas ayɛ Yuda mu bisibasaa, na wafom AWURADE nti, AWURADE brɛɛ Yuda ase. 19
Na Asiriahene Tilgat-pilneser baa ne so bɛhiahiaa
na Ahas kɔfaa AWURADE fie no ne ahemfie ne mmapɔmma no fie nnoɔma,
Na n’ahohiahia berɛ mu no Ɔhene Ahas
na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa Damasko anyame a wɔkaa no guiɛ no,
Na Ahas boaboaa Nyankopɔn fie nnwinneɛ ano na ɔtwitwaa
Na ɔyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea Yuda nkuro nyinaa mu, sɛ wɔnhye aduhwam mma anyame foforɔ, na ɔhuruu AWURADE n’agyanom Nyankopɔn no bo. 25
Na ne ho nsɛm nkaeɛ
Na Ahas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Yerusalem kuro no mu; na wɔamfa no ankɔ Israel ahemfo asieeɛ.
Hesekia bɛdii hene no na wadi mfeɛ aduonu nnum
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so sɛdeɛ n’agya Dawid yɛeɛ no ara.2
Ɔno deɛ n’ahennie afe a ɛdi kan no mu bosome
Na ɔde asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no baa mu, na ɔboaboaa wɔn ano apueeɛ mpraeɛ no so, 4
na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Lewifoɔ, montie, afei monyɛ mo ho kronkron,
Na yɛn agyanom fomee na wɔyɛɛ AWURADE
Nso wɔtoo ntwironowa no apono mu na wɔdunnumm nkanea
Enti na AWURADE abufuo baa Yuda ne Yerusalem soɔ
Na hwɛ yɛn agyanom atotɔ afena ano na
Afei ɛwɔ m’akoma mu, sɛ me ne AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn bɛpam, na n’abufuhyeɛ no afiri yɛn so akɔ. 10
Me mma afei monnyɛ aniha na mo
Ɛnna Lewifoɔ no sɔreeɛ Amasai ba Mahat ne Asaria
Ne Elisafan mma mu Simri ne Yeiel
ne Heman mma mu: Yehiel
Na wɔboaboaa wɔn nuanom ano na wɔyɛɛ
Na asɔfoɔ no hyɛnee AWURADE fie
Na bosome a ɛdi kan no da
ɛnna wɔhyɛnee mu baa Ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn, na wɔkaa sɛ: Yɛapepa AWURADE fie hɔ nyinaa ne ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho adeɛ nyinaa, ne nsiesieeɛ pono no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ho; 18
na nnoɔma a Ɔhene Ahas di hene no, ɔto guiɛ wɔ ne mmarato mu no nyi
Ɛnna Ɔhene Hesekia tuaa nhema boaboaa kuro no mmapɔmma no ano, na ɔforo kɔɔ AWURADE fie. 20
Na wɔde anantwinini nson ne adwennini
Na wɔkunkumm anantwie no na asɔfoɔ
Na wɔde bɔne ho afɔdeɛ mpapo no baa ɔhene badwa
Na asɔfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn na wɔde
Na ɔde Lewifoɔ no gyinagyinaa AWURADE fie, na wɔkurakura nnawuro ne mmɛnta ne asankuten sɛdeɛ Dawid ne ɔhene no Ɔdehunufoɔ Gad ne Odiyifoɔ
Na Lewifoɔ no de Dawid nsankuo
Na Hesekia kaa sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia no so.
Na badwa no nyinaa kotokotoe na wɔtotoo nnwom
Na wɔwiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ
Na Ɔhene Hesekia ne asafohene no ka kyerɛɛ Lewifoɔ
Na Hesekia kaa sɛ: Afei moadwira mo ho ama AWURADE, montwe mpini, na momfa okum afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ mmra AWURADE fie.
Na ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a badwa no de baeɛ
Na akronkronneɛ no yɛ anantwie ahansia ne nnwan mpensa. 33
Nanso na asɔfoɔ no nnɔɔso nti wɔn nko ara antumi anyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ
Nanso ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ
Na Hesekia ne ɔman no nyinaa ani gyee sɛ Onyankopɔn asiesie
Na Salomo firii aseɛ sii AWURADE fie no wɔ Yerusalem, Moria bepɔ a wɔkyerɛɛ n’agya Dawid no so, faako a Dawid hyɛeɛ, Yebusini Ornan ayuporebea hɔ.
Na ɔfirii aseɛ sii no bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu, n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu. 2
Na yei ne fapem a Salomo too sɛ ɔde resi AWURADE dan no: Ne ntwemu yɛ akane nsusuiɛ no mu basafa aduasa, na ne trɛ nso basafa du. 3
Na ntwonoowa a ɛwɔ ɛdan no trɛ anim
Na ɛdan kɛseɛ no ɔde pepeaa nnua kataa ho na
Na ɔde aboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den duraa ɛdan no ho sɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ.
Na ɔde sika kataa ɛdan no mpuna, aponnwa, n’afasuo ne n’apono ntanta no ho.
Na ɔyɛɛ kronkronkronbea dan no ne ntwemu sɛdeɛ ɛdan
Na deɛ wɔkari de yɛɛ nnadewa no ano si sika nnwetɛbena aduonum.
Na kronkron mu kronkronbea dan no
Na kerubim no ntaban ntwemu yɛ basafa du baako ataban
Na kerub baako no nso ataban yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa na ɛka ɛdan
Kerubim yi ntaban a wɔatrɛ mu no yɛ basafa du, na wɔgyinagyina wɔn nan so, na wɔn anim hwɛ ɛdan no. 13
Na ɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛberedum
Na ɔyɛɛ ɛdan no anim adum mmienu, n’atentene, basafa dunson ne fa, na aduntire a ɛwɔ atifi no basafa mmienu ne fa. 15
Na ɔyɛɛ ntweaban mpiakyire mu na ɔde sensɛnee adum no atifi
Na ɔmemaa adum no so sisii asɔredan
Na Hesekia soma maa wɔkɔɔ Israel ne Yuda nyinaa so na ɔtwerɛɛ nwoma nso kɔmaa Efraim
Na ɔhene no ne
Na wɔantumi anni no berɛ
Na nhyehyɛɛ no sɔɔ ɔhene ne badwa no nyinaa ani. 4
Na wɔhyɛɛ asɛm no so mmom sɛ wɔmpae
Na awɛmfoɔ de nwoma a ɛfiri ɔhene ne
Na monnyɛ sɛ mo agyanom ne
Afei monnsensene mo kɔn sɛ
Na sɛ mosane ba AWURADE nkyɛn a mo nuanom ne
Ɛnna asomafoɔ no sene firii kuro mu kɔɔ
Nanso ebinom a wɔfirii Aser ne Manase
Na Nyankopɔn nsa baa Yuda nso so sɛ ɔrema wɔn akoma korɔ
Na nkurɔfoɔ bebree boaa wɔn ano wɔ Yerusalem sɛ wɔrebɛdi apiti nnapɔnna no bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no so, badwa kɛseɛ pa ara. 13
Na wɔsɔre yiyii afɔrebukyia a ɛwowɔ Yerusalem no na aduhwamhyeɛ
Ɛnna wɔkumm Twam Dwan no bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu
Na wɔkɔgyinagyinaa wɔn agyinaeɛ sɛdeɛ
Ɛfiri sɛ na nnipa bebree wɔ badwa no mu a wɔnnya nyɛɛ wɔn ho kronkron
Na ɔman no mu dodoɔ nnipa bebree a wɔfiri Efraim ne Manase
obiara a wasiesie n’akoma sɛ ɔrehwehwɛ Onyankopɔn, AWURADE n’agyanom Nyankopɔn, mpo sɛ ɛnyɛ kronkronbea ahodwira so a. 19
Na AWURADE tiee Hesekia, na ɔsaa ɔman no yadeɛ.20
Na Israelfoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn Yerusalem no dii apiti nnapɔnna
Na Hesekia kaa Lewifoɔ a wɔwɔ AWURADE ho nimdeɛ pa no nyinaa abotɔyam asɛm, na wɔdii afahyɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ no nnanson, na wɔbobɔɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na wɔkamfoo AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no.22
Na badwa no nyinaa penee so sɛ wɔbɛdi Twam
Na Ɔhene Hesekia yii anantwinini apem ne nnwan mpemnson maa badwa no, na mmapɔmma no nso yii anantwie apem ne nnwan mpemdu maa badwa no.
Na Yuda badwa no nyinaa ne asɔfoɔ
Na anigyeɛ kɛseɛ baa Yerusalem
Ɛnna asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no sɔreeɛ na wɔhyiraa ɔman
Na wɔwiee yei nyinaa no Israelfoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn hɔ
Na Hesekia de asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no nkyekyɛmu so atitire
Na mmoa a ɛfiri ɔhene nnoɔma mu no wɔde ma ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anɔpa ne anwummerɛ
Na ɔhyɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔte Yerusalem no sɛ wɔmfa asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no kyɛfa mma, na wɔasɔ AWURADE mmara no mu den. 4
Na asɛm no hyetae

Na ɔkɔe, na ɔsoma ma wɔkɔɔ Yudahene Yehosafat nkyɛn sɛ: Moabhene ate m’anim atua, na wo ne me bɛkɔ ne Moab akɔko anaa?
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛbɛfa akorɔ?
Ɛnna Israel hene Yuda
Na Israel hene kaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ahyia sɛ wɔde wɔn rekɔhyɛ Moab nsa. 10
Na Yehosafat se: AWURADE diyifoɔ bi nni ha a yɛbɛkɔ ne nkyɛn akɔbisa AWURADE?
Na Yehosafat kaa sɛ: Ampa, ɔyɛ AWURADE diyifoɔ kɛseɛ. Ɛnna Israel hene ne Yehosafat ne Edomhene siane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn.12
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ? Kɔ w’agya adiyifoɔ ne wo na adiyifoɔ no nkyɛn!
Na Elisa kaa sɛ Sɛ asafo AWURADE a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi
Na afei momfa sankubɔni mmrɛ me.
na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mɛma nsuo ahyɛ ame
Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Morenhunu mframa na morenhunu osuo, nanso nsuo bɛyɛ bonhwa yi ma; na moanom, mo ne mo nantwikuo ne mo mmoa. 17
Na yei nso yɛ mmrɛ wɔ AWURADE ani so, na ɔbɛyi Moab nso ahyɛ mo nsa. 18
Na mobɛbubu wɔn nkuro akɛseɛ ho afasuo na moafa
Na anɔpa a wɔrebɔ aduane afɔdeɛ no, hwɛ, nsuo firii Edom kwan so bae, na nsuo no yɛɛ asase no ma.20
Na Moabfoɔ nyinaa tee sɛ ahemfo no reforo aba ne wɔn abɛko
Na wɔsɔree anɔpatutu a owia repue nsuo no soɔ
na wɔkaa sɛ: Mogya nie! Ahemfo no ne wɔn ho adi nnɔmmata akunkum wɔn ho,
Na wɔbaa Israel nsraban mu no
Na nkuro no wɔdwirii na mfu pa nyinaa wɔtotoo aboɔ guguu so mmaako
Na Moabhene hunuu sɛ ɛdɔm no ano ayɛ den papa ama
Ɛnna ɔfaa n’abakan a anka ɔbɛsi n’ananmu adi hene no na ɔde
Na adiyifoɔ mma no mu baako yere teaa
Na Elisa bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na menyɛ memma woɔ? Kyerɛ me ɛ, ɛdeɛn na wowɔ wɔ efie?
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Firi adi kɔfemfɛm nhina wɔ wɔn a wɔtete bɛn woɔ nyinaa nkyɛn, nhina hunu, ma no nnɔɔso. 3
Na sɛ woba mu a to wo ne
Na ɔfirii ne nkyɛn kɔe na ɔkɔtoo
Na ɛbaa sɛ nhina no yeyɛɛ amaama
Ɛnna ɔba bɛka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no Na ɔkaa sɛ Kɔ na kɔtɔn ngo
Na da bi Elisa sene kɔɔ Sunem.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ Hwɛ mahunu
ma yɛnyɛ abansoro fasuo mu pia ketewa bi, na yɛmfa mpadua, ɛpono, adwa ne kaneadua nsisi hɔ m
Na da bi ɔbaa hɔ, na ɔmane kɔɔ abansoro pia no mu kɔdaa hɔ. 11
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra Gehasi sɛ: Kɔfrɛ Sunemni no bra!
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ Gehasi sɛ Bisa no
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Gehasi, ɛdeɛn na wɔnyɛ mma no?
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Frɛ no!
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Afeda sɛsɛberɛ yi mu no, wobɛwo ɔba.
Nanso ɔbaa no nyinsɛnee na ɔwoo ɔbabarima afeda
Na abɔfra no nyinii.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Me ti, me ti!
Na ɔmaa no so de
Na ɔforo de no kɔtoo Nyankopɔn nipa
Na ɔkɔfrɛɛ ne kunu sɛ Mesrɛ wo soma mmeranteɛ no mu baako
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ Adɛn nti na wopɛ
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ afunumubereɛ no na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra
Na ɔsii mu, na ɔbɛduruu Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn Karmel bepɔ so.
Afei tu mmirika kɔhyia no na bisa
Na ɔduruu Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn bepɔ
Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Mebɛsrɛɛ me wura hɔ ɔba? Manka sɛ: Nnaadaa me anaa!
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ Gehasi sɛ Bɔ abɔsoɔ na fa me poma kura
Na abɔfra no na kaa sɛ Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ
Na Gehasi dii wɔn anim kɔe na ɔde poma no kɔtoo abɔfra
Na Elisa duruu fie hɔ no, ɔhunuu sɛ, abɔfra no awu da ne mpa so. 32
Ɛnna ɔkɔɔ mu, na ɔtoo wɔn baanu pono mu, na ɔbɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ.
Na ɔforo kɔbutuu abɔfra no so na ɔde n’ano butuu
Ɛnna ɔsane ba bɛnantee ɛdan no mu dii hɔ akɔneaba. Na ɔforo kɔɔ bio kɔponoo ne mu wɔ ne so:
Na ɔfrɛɛ Gehasi sɛ: Frɛ Sunemni no!
Ɛnna ɔba bɛhwee ne nan ase kotoo no butuu fam, na ɔfaa ne ba no firii adi.37
Na Elisa sane baa Gilgal.
Na ɔbaako firi kɔɔ wiram sɛ ɔrekɔtete fan na ɔkɔhunuu
Ɛnna wɔhwie maa nnipa no sɛ wɔnni Na wɔredi aduane
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnneɛ momfa esiam mmra.
Na ɔbarima bi nso firi Baal-salisa bae, na ɔbrɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no aba a ɛdi kan paanoo, atokoɔ paanoo aduonu ne ayuo foforɔ a wɔnhwaneeɛ.
Na ne somfoɔ no bisaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn? Memfa yei mensi nnipa ɔha anim anaa?
Ɛnna ɔde sii wɔn anim na wɔdii
Na Siriahene sahene
Na Siria asafo no mu bi akɔto ahyɛ Israelfoɔ so afa abaayewa kumaa bi dommum aba; na ɔsom
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’awuraa sɛ Aa
Ɛnna ɔkɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ ne wura sɛ Sɛɛ
Na Siriahene no kaa sɛ: Kɔ na bra, na mɛtwerɛ Israel hene no nwoma.5
Na ɔsii mu kɔe, na ɔfaa dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ du ne sika nnwetɛbena mpemnsia ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho du kurae.
Na ɔde nwoma no brɛɛ Israel hene sɛ Sɛ
Na ɛbaa sɛ Israel hene kenkan nwoma no ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu kaa
Na Nyankopɔn nipa Elisa tee sɛ Israel hene asunsuane ne ntadeɛ mu no ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ ɔhene
Ɛnna Naaman ne n’apɔnkɔ
Na Elisa somaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no kɔɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ: Kɔ na kɔdware Yordan mu mprɛnson, na wo honam bɛsane aba wo ho, na wo ho afi. 10
Ɛnna Naaman bo fuiɛ na ɔsii mu kɔe kaa sɛ Hwɛ mesusuu
Damasko nsubɔntene Abana ne Parpar nyɛ nsene Israel nsuo nyinaa? Anka merennware mu na me ho mfi anaa? Na ɔdanee ne ho de abufuo sii mu. 12
Na ne nkoa twe pinii bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ M’agya
Ɛnna ɔsiane de ne ho kɔbɔɔ Yordan mu mprɛnson sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa asɛm no teɛ
Na ɔsane baa Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn, ɔno ne n’asafo nyinaa, na ɔba bɛgyinaa n’anim kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, mahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn bi nni asase biara so sɛ Israel nko, na afei gye akyɛdeɛ yi w’akoa nsam.
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, merennye hwee.

Asɛm yi mu nko na AWURADE mfa nkyɛ w’akoa sɛ me wura rekɔ Rimon fie akɔsɔre hɔ
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu.19

Na Nyankopɔn nipa Elisa abɔfra Gehasi kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, me wura agyaa Siriani
Na Gehasi tii
Na ɔse Asomdwoeɛ mu Me wura asoma me sɛ Hwɛ seesei mmeranteɛ baanu a wɔfiri adiyifoɔ mma no
Na
Na ɔduruu kokoɔ no ho
Na ɔno deɛ, ɔba bɛgyinaa ne wura anim.
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ M’akoma ne wo ankɔ berɛ a ɔbarima
Na
Na adiyifoɔ mma no ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: Hwɛ, w’anim ha a yɛteɛ yi yɛ hiahiaa papa ma yɛn. 1
Ma yɛnkɔ Yordan ano na yɛnkɔfa mpuna mmaako
Na ɔbaako kaa sɛ: Pene na ɛne wo nkoa nkɔ.
Na ɔne wɔn sii mu kɔe.
Na ɔbaako rebu dua no n’akuma
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no bisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na ɛtɔeɛ?
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma so fa!
Na Siriahene ne Israel bɛdii ako na ɔne
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no soma maa wɔkɔɔ Israel hene nkyɛn sɛ: Hwɛ yie, na wɔamfa saa bea yi so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na Siriafoɔ nam reba. 9
Na Israel hene soma maa wɔkɔɔ faako a Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ
Ɛnna Siriahene akoma peree no asɛm yi ho; na ɔfrɛɛ ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Morenkyerɛ me yɛn mu deɛ ɔwɔ Israel hene afa? 11
Na ne nkoa no mu baako kaa sɛ: Me wura Ɔhene, ɛnte saa, na mmom Odiyifoɔ Elisa a ɔwɔ Israel no na ɔka nsɛm a woka no wo dabekyire no kyerɛ Israel hene. 12
Na ɔse: Monkɔ nkɔsra baabi a ɔwɔ, na mensoma mma wɔnkɔfa no mmra.
Ɛnna ɔsomaa apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no somfoɔ tuaa nhema sɛ ɔresɔre afiri adie
Na ɔse: Nsuro, na wɔn a wɔka yɛn ho dɔɔso sene wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho no.
Na Elisa bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE, bue n’ani na ɔnhunu!
Ɛnna Siriafoɔ siane baa ne so, na Elisa bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, fa anifira bɔ dɔm yi; na ɔde anifira bɔɔ wɔn, sɛdeɛ Elisa asɛm no teɛ no.
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ Ɛnyɛ ɔkwan nie na ɛnyɛ kuro no
Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔduruu Samaria no Elisa bɔɔ mpaeɛ
Na Israel hene hunuu wɔn no, ɔbisaa Elisa sɛ: M’agya, memmobɔ wɔn anaa? 21
Na ɔbuaa sɛ Dabi mmobɔ wɔn Deɛ wode wo nkrantɛ ne
Na ɔtoo ɛpono kɛseɛ maa wɔn na wɔdidiiɛ
Na ɛno akyiri no Siriahene Ben-hadad boaa ne dɔm nyinaa ano hyiae, na ɔforo ba bɛtuaa Samaria. 24
Na ɛkɔm kɛseɛ baa Samaria, na hwɛ, wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ mu ara de kɔsii sɛ wɔtɔn afunumu ti gyee nnwetɛbena aduɔwɔtwe, na mmuruburo bini kab abupɛn nnan mu baako gyee nnwetɛbena nnum 25
Na Israel hene retwam ɔfasuo no soɔ
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE ammoa wo a, mɛfiri he na maboa woɔ? Ɛmfiri ayuporebea anaa nsa-kyi-amena mu? 27
Na Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ woɔ?
Na yɛnoaa me ba no weeɛ na adeɛ kyeeɛ
Na ɔhene tee ɔbaa no nsɛm
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ wɔankum Safat ba Elisa nnɛ da yi a, Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sei na ɔnto so sei.31
Nanso na Elisa te ne fie
Na ɔda so ne wɔn rekasa no, hwɛ, na ɔbɔfoɔ no resiane aba ne nkyɛn.
Ɛnna Elisa kaa sɛ Montie AWURADE asɛm Sɛ
Ɛnna okunini a ɔhene twere ne nsa soɔ no buaa Nyankopɔn nipa
Na mmarima akwatafoɔ baanan wɔ kuro no pono ano, na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Adɛn na yɛtete ha kɔsi sɛ yɛbɛwuwuo?
Sɛ yɛse Yɛbɛhyɛne kuro no mu a ɛnneɛ ɛkɔm wɔ
Na wɔsɔree anwummerɛ fɔmm sɛ wɔrekɔ Siriafoɔ nsraban mu:
Na AWURADE ama Siriafoɔ dɔm ate nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ
Enti anwummerɛ no wɔasɔre adwane na wɔagyigya wɔn ntomadan ne
Na akwatafoɔ no duruu nsraban
Ɛnna wɔsesee wɔn ho
Na wɔba bɛfrɛɛ kuro no apono ano ahwɛfoɔ na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ Yɛkɔɔ Siriafoɔ nsraban mu
Na ɛpono ano ahwɛfoɔ no frɛe maa wɔkɔkaa no ahemfie.11
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔree anadwo no na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ Mɛkyerɛ mo deɛ Siriafoɔ ayɛ yɛn yi Wɔnim
Na ne nkoa no mu baako buaa sɛ Ɛnneɛ ma wɔmfa apɔnkɔ nkaeɛ a wɔaka kurom ha
Na wɔfaa apɔnkɔ nteaseɛnam mmienu na ɔhene somaa wɔn maa wɔdii Siriafoɔ dɔm no akyiri sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwɛ! 14
Na wɔdii wɔn akyi de kɔduruu Yordan ano na hwɛ ntadeɛ ne nnoɔma
Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ no firii adie kɔfom Siriafoɔ nsraban
Na ɔhene yii okunini a ɔtwere ne nsa soɔ no sɛ ɔnhwɛ ɛpono ano na nkurɔfoɔ
Na ɛbaa mu sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene
Na ɔsafohene no buaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ:
Na ɛyɛɛ no saa ara na nkurɔfoɔ
Na Elisa aka akyerɛ ɔbaa a ɔnyanee ne ba no sɛ Sɔre kɔ wo
Na ɔbaa no sɔree yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa
Na ɛbaa sɛ mfeɛ nson no awieeɛ
Nso na ɔhene ne Nyankopɔn nipa no abɔfra Gehasi rekasa sɛ: Ka me nnoɔma akɛseɛ a Elisa ayɛ no ɛ! 4
Na ɔgu so reka kyerɛ ɔhene sɛdeɛ Elisa nyanee owufoɔ no, hwɛ, ɔbaa a ɔnyanee ne ba maa no no bɛsrɛɛ ɔhene sɛ ɔregye ne fie ne n’asase.
Na ɔhene bisaa ɔbaa no
Na Elisa kɔɔ Damasko nso na Siriahene Ben-hadad yare
Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Hasael sɛ: Fa ayɛyɛdeɛ kura wo nsam, na kɔ kɔhyia Nyankopɔn nipa no, na kɔbisa AWURADE adeɛ ne hɔ sɛ: Mɛnya yadeɛ yi mu nkwa anaa? 8
Na Hasael ba bɛhyiaa no, na ɔfaa ayɛyɛdeɛ kurae, ɛyɛ Damasko nnoɔma pa nyinaa mu bi, yoma aduanan na ɛsoso wɔn.
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Kɔ kɔka kyerɛ
Na ɔgyenee n’ani hwɛɛ no dinn kɔsii sɛ
Na Hasael bisaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na me wura resu?
Na Hasael kaa sɛ:
Na ɔfirii Elisa nkyɛn kɔ kɔduruu ne wura nkyɛn.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no ɔfaa mmuatoma
Na Israelhene Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so nnum mu berɛ
Ɔbɛdii hene no na wadi mfirinhyia aduasa mmienu
Na ɔfaa Israel ahemfo kwan so sɛdeɛ Ahab fie yɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ne yere yɛ Ahab ba.
Nanso n’akoa Dawid nti AWURADE ampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe Yuda, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛma no ne ne mma nna nyinaa.
Ne berɛ so na Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa aseɛ, na wɔkɔsii wɔn so hene. 20
Na Yoram twaa mu kɔɔ Sair ne nteaseɛnam nyinaa ka
Na Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa ase de bɛsi nnɛ. Ɛnna Libna nso tee atua berɛ no ara mu. 22
Na Yoram ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu? 23
Na Yoram tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando na wɔsiee no kaa
Na Israelhene Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so dummienu mu na Yudahene Yehoram ba Ahasia bɛdii hene.
Ahasia dii mfeɛ aduonu mmienu na ɔbɛdii hene no
Na ɔfaa Ahab fiefoɔ kwan so na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani
Na ɔne Ahab ba Yoram ne Siriahene Hasael kɔkoeɛ wɔ Ramot-gilead.
Na Ɔhene Yoram sane baa sɛ ɔrebɛsa pira a Siriafoɔ piraa no Rama, berɛ a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no wɔ Yesreel.
Na Odiyifoɔ Elisa frɛɛ adiyifoɔ mma no mu baako ka kyerɛɛ
Na sɛ woduru hɔ a hwehwɛ Nimsi ba Yehosafat
na fa ngo toa no hwie gu n’atifi,
Ɛnna aberanteɛ a ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ
Na ɔduruiɛ no na hwɛ ɛdɔm so asafohene tete hɔ
Ɛnna ɔsɔre kɔɔ ɛdan no mu na ɔhwiee ngo
Na wobɛbɔ wo wura Ahab fie, na matɔ me nkoa adiyifoɔ no mogya ne AWURADE nkoa nyinaa mogya so were Isebel nsam;
na Ahab fie nyi
Na mɛyɛ Ahab fie sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fie ne Ahia ba Baasa fie.
Na akraman bɛwe Isebel nam, Yesreel asase so, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛsie no.
Na Yehu firii adi baa ne wura nkoa nkyɛn.
Na wɔse: Atorɔ! Ka kyerɛ yɛn ɛ!
Ɛnna wɔyɛɛ ntɛm yiyii wɔn ntadeɛ de hyehyɛɛ n’ase
Na Nimsi ba Yehosafat
na Ɔhene Yehoram deɛ,
Na Yehu tenaa teaseɛnam mu kɔɔ Yesreel.
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ gyina Yesreel abantenten so; na ɔhunuu Yehu asafokuo no sɛ wɔreba, na ɔkaa sɛ: Mehunu asafokuo bi.
Na ɔpɔnkɔsoteni bi kɔ kɔhyiaa no, na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Asomdwoeɛ anaa?
Ɛnna ɔsomaa ɔpɔnkɔsoteni a ɔtɔ so mmienu; na ɔkɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn no, ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Ɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ anaa? Na Yehu se: Asomdwoeɛ fa wo ho bɛn? Bra bɛdi m’akyi! 19
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Waduru wɔn nkyɛn, nso ɔnsane mma.
Ɛnna Yehoram kaa sɛ Monsiesie! Na wɔsiesiee ne teaseɛnam no
Na Yehoram hunuu Yehu no, ɔbisaa sɛ: Yehu, asomdwoeɛ anaa?
Ɛnna Yehoram danee ne ho dwaneeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ahasia sɛ: Atirisopamsɛm nie, Ahasia! 23
Na Yehu de n’ahoɔden nyinaa twee n’agyan mu to bɔɔ Yehoram abasa ntam, na agyan no hwiree n’akoma mu, na ɔhwee ne teaseɛnam mu. 24
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunini Bidkar sɛ Ma no so to
Ampa ara mehunuu Nabot mogya ne
Na Yudahene Ahasia hunuiɛ no, ɔfaa turom dan kwan so dwanee.
Na ne nkoa de no nam teaseɛnam mu kɔɔ Yerusalem; na wɔsiee no n’asieeɛ kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kuro mu.28
Na Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so dubaako mu na Ahasia bɛdii Yuda so hene.29
Ɛnna Yehu baa Yesreel. Na Isebel teeɛ no, ɔkekaa n’ani ho adubire, na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne ti, na ɔhwɛɛ mpomma mu. 30
Na Yehu duruu ɛpono no ano
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛɛ mpomma no na ɔbisaa sɛ Hwan
Na ɔkaa sɛ Monto no nhwe fam! Ɛnna wɔtoo
Na ɔhyɛnee mu na ɔdidiiɛ

Na ɔne me kaa nsɛm yi no, mede m’anim mesii fam, na metɔree mum. 15
Na hwɛ, obi a ɔte sɛ nnipa mma nsɛsoɔ kaa m’anofafa, na mebuee m’ano mekasa ka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔgyinaa m’anim no sɛ: Owura, anisoadehunu no mu maboto ahima, na ahoɔden biara nni me mu;
na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn
Na obi a ɔte sɛ onipa nsɛsoɔ sane bɛkaa me bio, na ɔhyɛɛ me den; 18
na ɔse Nsuro ɔdɔfo asomdwoeɛ nka wo yɛ den! Yɛ
Na ɔse: Wonim deɛ enti a mebaa wo nkyɛn?
Nanso merekyerɛ wo deɛ wɔakurukyire no nokorɛ nwoma mu, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛgyina asɔ me mu atia yeinom gye Mikael, mo bapɔmma no.21
Na me deɛ, Mediani Dario afe a ɛdi kan mu no megyinaa sɛ meresɔ ne mu na mahyɛ no den.1
Na afei na merekyerɛ wo nokorɛ no Hwɛ ahemfo baasa bɛda so asɔre wɔ Persia
Na ɔhene dɔmmarima bi bɛsɔre, na ɔde tumi kɛseɛ bɛdi hene, na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ. 3
Na ɔgyina a n’ahennie bɛbɔ na wɔakyɛ mu akɔ ɔsoro mframa nnan no
Na anafoɔ fam hene no bɛyɛ den nanso ne mmapɔmma mu baako
Na mfeɛ bi akyiri no wɔbɛfefa wɔn ho ayɔnkoɔ na anafoɔ fam hene
Na ɔbaa no nhini mu duban bi a ɛfefɛeɛ bɛsɔre asi n’ananmu na ɔde dɔm bɛba
Na ɔbɛfa wɔn anyame nso ne
Na ɔbɛba anafoɔ fam hene no ahennie mu deɛ, nanso ɔbɛsane akɔ n’asase so.9
Na ne mma bɛdi ako na wɔbɛboa dɔm akɛseɛ asafo yuu ano
Na anafoɔ fam hene no ani bɛbere, na ɔbɛfiri aba ne ɔno atifi fam hene no abɛko.
Na anafoɔ hene asafo yuu no bɛsɔre, na n’akoma ama ne ho so, na ɔbɛka mpem du du agu fam, nanso ɔrenni nim nkyɛre. 12
Na atifi fam hene no bɛsane de asafo yuu a ɛso sene kane deɛ
Na mmerɛ no mu
Na atifi fam hene no bɛba na wabɛhɔre dosie
Na deɛ ɔba ne soɔ no bɛyɛ sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛgyina n’anim; na ɔbɛgyina asase fɛfɛ no so, na ɔde ne nsa asɛe no.
Na ɔde bɛsi n’anim sɛ
Na ɔbɛdane n’ani akyerɛ nsuano aman, na ɔbɛfa bebree.
Na ɔbɛdane n’ani akyerɛ ɔno ara n’asase so abankɛseɛ, nanso ɔbɛsunti ahwe ase, na wɔrenhu no.19
Na obi bɛsɔre asi n’ananmu a ɔbɛma ɔtogyefoɔ pempensifoɔ bi abɛfa ahemman no animuonyanneɛ mu akorɔ, nanso nna kakraa bi mu wɔbɛsɛe no, nso ɛnyɛ abufuo anaa ɔsa mu. 20
Na ɔhohorani bi bɛsɔre asi n’ananmu a wɔmfaa ahennie mu animuonyam mmaa no; na ɔbɛfiri awora aba de tɛkyerɛmakyene abɛfa ahennie no mu.
Na wɔde abasa a ɛte sɛ nsuyire bɛpia wɔn akɔ na wɔabubu wɔn ne apam berempɔn no nso wɔ n’anim. 22
Nanso ɔne no pam wie a ɔbɛtwa
ɔbɛfiri awora aba asase no so deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ fɔɔfɔɔ na wabɛyɛ
Na ɔde dɔm kɛseɛ bɛkanyan n’ahoɔden ne mmaninyɛ atia anafoɔ fam hene no na
Na wɔn a wɔne no to nsa didie na ɛbɛsɛe
Na ahemfo baanu no deɛ, wɔn akoma bɛdwene asɛmmɔne na wɔaka atorosɛm didipono baako ho; nanso ɛrenyɛ wɔn mfasoɔ biara, ɛfiri sɛ awieeɛ no bɛba ara ɛberɛ a wɔahyɛ no mu. 27
Na atifi hene no de ahodeɛ kɛseɛ bɛsane akɔ n’asase so, nanso n’ani bɛsa apam kronkron no ara, na ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ na wasane akɔ n’asase so.28
Berɛ a wɔahyɛ no mu, ɔbɛsane aba anafoɔ fam, nanso akyire deɛ no renyɛ sɛ kane deɛ no. 29
Na Kitifoɔ ahyɛn bɛba ne so enti n’akoma bɛtu na wasane
Na ɔde asraafoɔ bɛsisi hɔ na wɔagu kronkronbea ne aban no ho fi
Na wɔn a wɔbɔ apam no ho mmusuo
Na ɔman no mu wɔn a wɔnim de
Na sɛ wɔtotɔ saa a, wɔde mmoa ketewaa bi na ɛbɛboa wɔn, na nnipa bebree de adɔkɔdɔkɔsɛm bɛbata wɔn ho. 34
Na mmadwemma no bi bɛtotɔ na wɔde ayi wɔn mu fi de ate
Na ɔhene no bɛyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ na ɔbɛma ne ho so adi onyame biara
Na ɔremmu ne nananom anyame na
Na ɔbɛdi abandenden nyame no ni asi wɔn ananmu, na onyame a ne nananom nnim no no, ɔde sika ne dwetɛ ne abohene ne afɛfɛdeɛ bɛdi no ni. 38
Na ɔde onyame nanani bi na ɛne abandenden a ɛyɛ den koraa no bɛdie deɛ ɔbu
Na awieeɛ berɛ no mu na anafoɔ fam hene
Na ɔbɛba asase fɛfɛ no so na nnipa bebree bɛtotɔ
Na ɔbɛtene ne nsa nsase no so, na Misraim asase remfiri mu mfi, 42
na ɔbɛnya sika ne dwetɛ akoradeɛ ne Misraim afɛfɛdeɛ nyi
Nanso nsɛm a ɔbɛte afiri apueeɛ ne atifi fam bɛyi no hu, na ɔde anibereɛ kɛseɛ bɛfiri akɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsɛe na wadwerɛ nnipa bebree. 44
Na ɔbɛsi n’ahemfie ntomadan ɛpo no ne bepɔ fɛfɛ kronkron
Ɛberɛ no mu na Mikael ɔbɔfoɔ titire a ɔgyina hɔ ma wo man mma
Na wɔn a wɔadeda fam dɔteɛ mu no bebree bɛnyane, ebinom bɛkɔ daa nkwa mu, na ebinom akɔ ahohoradeɛ ne daa ahiyie mu.
Na mmadwemma no bɛhyerɛn sɛdeɛ ewiem hyerɛn, na wɔn a wɔdane nnipa bebree kɔɔ tenenee mu no bɛyɛ sɛ nsoromma daa daapem.3
Na wo Daniel toto nsɛm no mu na sɔ nwoma
Na me Daniel mehwɛe na hwɛ
Na ɔbaako ka kyerɛɛ ɔbarima a ɔfira nwera
Na metee onipa a ɔfira nwera
Na metee na mante aseɛ
Na ɔse: Daniel, kɔ ɛ, na wɔatoto nsɛm no mu asɔ ano de rekɔsi awieeɛ berɛ no so. 9
Wɔbɛte nnipa bebree ho ahoa wɔn
Na ɛfiri berɛ a wɔbɛyi daa afɔdeɛ na wɔde akyiwadeɛ
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔtwɛn na ɔkɔduru nna apem ahasa aduasa nnum no soɔ. 12
Na wo Daniel deɛ kɔ kɔduru awieeɛ na woakɔhome
Na Nebukadnessar ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, ɔsosoo daeɛ bi, na ne honhom ho yeraa no, na n’ani soroe.
Ɛnna ɔhene kaa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ nkonyaayifoɔ, pɛadeahunufoɔ, ntafowayifoɔ ne Kaldeafoɔ mmra, na wɔmmɛkyerɛ ɔhene daeɛ no. Na wɔba bɛgyinaa ɔhene anim.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Maso daeɛ bi, na me honhom ho yera me sɛ mɛkae daeɛ no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ. 3
Ɛnna Kaldeafoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene (wɔ Aramaik kasa mu) sɛ: Ɔhene nnya nkwa daa! Ka wo daeɛ no kyerɛ wo nkoa, na yɛnkyerɛ aseɛ.
Ɔhene bua see Kaldeafoɔ no sɛ Deɛ maka
Na sɛ mokyerɛ me daeɛ no ne n’ase a mobɛnya
Wɔbuaa no ne mprenu so sɛ: Ma ɔhene nka daeɛ no nkyerɛ ne nkoa, na yɛnkyerɛ aseɛ. 7
Ɔhene buaa sɛ Menim ampa
Sɛ moankyerɛ me daeɛ no a asɛm rebɛto mo ɛfiri sɛ moadwene atorosɛm ne nnaadaasɛm
Kaldeafoɔ no buaa ɔhene sɛ Onipa biara nni asase so a ɔbɛtumi akyerɛ
Na asɛm a ɔhene rebisa yi yɛ den dodo na obiara biara nni hɔ
Yei nti ɔhene bo fui, na n’ani beree kɛse, na ɔkaa sɛ wɔnkum Babel anyansafoɔ nyinaa. 12
Enti mmara no baa sɛ wɔnkum anyansafoɔ
Ɛnna Daniel de kasa pa ne nyansa
sɛ: Adɛn nti na ɔhene hyɛɛ mmara a ɛyɛ den seyie? Ɛnna Ariok kaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ Daniel. 15
Na Daniel kɔ kɔsrɛɛ ɔhene sɛ ɔmma no berɛ na wakyerɛ no daeɛ no ase.16
Ɛnna Daniel firi kɔɔ ne fie, na ɔkɔkaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ ne mfɛfoɔ Hanania, Misael ne Asaria, 17
sɛ wɔnsrɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn hɔ mmɔborɔhunu, ahunta
Ɛnna wɔyii ahuntasɛm no kyerɛɛ Daniel anadwo anisoadehunu mu.
Daniel kaa sɛ:20
Nhyira nka Nyankopɔn din daa daa,
sɛ nyansa ne tumi, ɔno na ɛwɔ no;
ɔno na ɔsakyera berɛ ne nna;21
ɔtu ahene, na ɔsi ahene,
ɔma anyansafoɔ nyansa,
na ɔde nimdeɛ ma wɔn a wɔwɔ nhunumu;
ɔyi deɛ emu dɔ ne deɛ ahunta adi,22
ɔnim deɛ ɛwɔ esum mu,
na hann ne no
Wo, m’agyanom Nyankopɔn,23
na meda wo ase, meyi wo ayɛ,
sɛ woama me nyansa ne tumi,
na afei woayi deɛ yɛsrɛɛ woɔ akyerɛ me,
sɛ woama yɛahunu ɔhene daeɛ no.
Ɛno nti Daniel kɔɔ Ariok a ɔhene ayi no sɛ ɔnkum Babel anyansafoɔ
Ɛnna Ariok yɛɛ ntɛm de Daniel kɔɔ ɔhene anim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mahunu Yuda atukɔfoɔ no mu barima bi a ɔbɛkyerɛ ɔhene daeɛ no aseɛ. 25
Ɔhene bisaa Daniel a ne din de Beltesasar sɛ: Wobɛtumi akyerɛ me daeɛ a mesoeɛ no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ?26
Daniel buaa ɔhene sɛ Ahuntasɛm a
nanso Onyankopɔn bi wɔ ɔsoro a ɔyi ahuntasɛm adie, na wakyerɛ Ɔhene Nebukadnessar deɛ ɛrebɛba daakye. Wo daeɛ ne w’anisoadeɛ a woda wo mpa soɔ no wohunuiɛ no nie: 28
Ɔhene, wodwenee nnoɔma pii ho wɔ wo mpa so, deɛ yei akyi ɛbɛba no ho, na deɛ ɔyi ahuntasɛm adie no ama woahunu deɛ ɛrebɛba no.
Na me deɛ ɛnyɛ nyansa a ɛwɔ
Wo ɔhene wohwɛe na hwɛ
Ohoni no nie Ne tiri yɛ sika pa ne koko
N’asrɛ yɛ dadeɛ ne nan mu bi
Wohwɛe ara kɔsii sɛ ɔboɔ bi a nsa biara nkura mu te bɛbɔɔ ohoni no nan a ɛyɛ dadeɛ ne dɔteɛ no, na ɛbubuu no muhumuhu; 34
ɛnna dadeɛ dɔteɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ dwetɛ ne sika no bubuu muhumuhu prɛko pɛ na ɛyɛɛ sɛ ahuhuberɛ mu ayuporebea so ntɛtɛ
Daeɛ no nie, na yɛbɛka ne nkyerɛaseɛ nso akyerɛ ɔhene. 36
Wo, ɔhene, woyɛ ahene mu hene a ɔsoro Nyankopɔn de ahennie, tumi, ahoɔden ne animuonyam ama woɔ,
na baabiara a nnipa mma, wiram mmoa ne ewiem nnomaa teɛ no, ɔde wɔn ahyɛ wo nsa,
Na w’akyi na ahennie foforɔ bɛsɔre a ɛnnuru wo deɛ no ne
Na ahennie a ɛtɔ so nnan no bɛyɛ den sɛ dadeɛ na sɛdeɛ
Na sɛdeɛ wohunuu nan ne nansoaa a emu bi yɛ ɔnwomfoɔ dɔteɛ
Na nansoaa a emu bi yɛ dadeɛ na ebi
na sɛdeɛ wohunuu dɔteɛ sɛ afrafra dadeɛ no, nnipa no bɛdi afra, wɔn asefoɔ mu,
Na ahemfo no nna
Ɛno nti sɛdeɛ wohunuu sɛ ɔboɔ a nsa anka te firii bepɔ no ho na ɛbɛbubuu dadeɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɛfa dwetɛ ne sika
Ɛno na Ɔhene Nebukadnessar de n’anim butuu fam
Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Daniel sɛ: Ampa ara, mo Nyankopɔn yɛ anyame mu Nyame ne ahemfo wura ne deɛ ɔyi ahuntasɛm adie, sɛ woatumi ayi saa ahuntasɛm yi adie.
Ɛnna ɔhene yɛɛ Daniel kɛseɛ na ɔmaa no ayɛyɛdeɛ akɛseɛ bebree
Na Daniel srɛɛ ɔhene, na ɔde Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego yeyɛɛ Babel asase mu nsɛm so ahwɛfoɔ.
Ɔhene Nebukadnessar yɛɛ sika honi a ne tentene yɛ basafa dunum na
Na Ɔhene Nebukadnessar somaa sɛ wɔnkɔhyiahyia amantam ahemfo mmakoma ne amradofoɔ atemmufoɔ mpanin nsannaafoɔ mmaratwerɛfoɔ
Ɛnna amantam ahemfo mmakoma ne amradofoɔ atemmufoɔ mpanin nsannaafoɔ mmaratwerɛfoɔ asennifoɔ
Na ɛsɛn bi teaa mu denden sɛ: Mo, nkurɔfoɔ, aman ne kasa ahodoɔ, wɔka kyerɛ mo sɛ: 4
Ɛberɛ a mobɛte abɛn odurugya sankuo sambuka
Na deɛ ɔrenhwe ase nsɔre no dɔn
Saa nti berɛ a wɔtee abɛn odurugya sankuo sambuka
Saa berɛ no ara mu Kaldeafoɔ bi kɔtoatoaa Yudafoɔ no; 8
kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Nebukadnessar sɛ
Wo na woahyɛ mmara sɛ onipa biara a ɔbɛte abɛn odurugya sankuo sambuka
na deɛ wanhwe ase ansɔre no, wɔde no bɛto ogya a ɛrefra
Ɔhene, Yudafoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a wode wɔn asisi Babel asase mu nsɛm so ahwɛfoɔ, Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego; mmarima yi mmu wo, wɔnsom w’anyame, na wɔnsɔre sika honi a wode asi hɔ no.12
Ɛnna Nebukadnessar de abufuo ne anibereɛ kaa sɛ wɔnkɔfa Sadrak Mesak
Nebukadnessar bisaa wɔn sɛ: Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego, moboapa na monsom m’anyame, na monsɔre sika honi a mede masi hɔ no anaa? 14
Afei deɛ sɛ moasiesie mo ho
Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego buaa Ɔhene Nebukadnessar sɛ: Ɛnhia yɛn sɛ yɛbɛbua wo yei ho asɛm biara. 16
Hwɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛsom no
Na sɛ amma saa mpo a ɔhene hunu
Ɛno na abufuhyeɛ hyɛɛ Nebukadnessar ma
Na ɔhyɛɛ mmarima bi ne dɔm mu
Ɛnna wɔkyekyeree mmarima yi wɔn ntwontwo togase
Na ɛsiane sɛ ɔhene asɛm no mu yɛ den na fononoo
Na mmarima baasa yi, Sadrak, Mesak, ne Abed-Nego a wɔakyekyere wɔn no hwehwee ogya a ɛrefranam fononoo no mu.23
Ɛnna Ɔhene Nebukadnessar ho dwirii no na ɔsɔre ntɛmntɛm
Ɔkaa sɛ Hwɛ mehunu mmarima baanan a wɔasane wɔn
Ɛnna Nebukadnessar bɛn ogya a ɛrefranam fononoo no mu
Na amantam ahemfo mmakoma ne amradofoɔ
Nebukadnessar kaa sɛ Nhyira ne Sadrak Mesak
Ne saa nti, mehyɛ mmara sɛ ɔman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa ahodoɔ nyinaa mu biara a ɔka Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-
Ɛnna ɔhene maa Sadrak, Mesak ne Abed-Nego dii yie Babel asase soɔ.30
Ɔhene Nebukadnessar de yei kɔmaa aman, nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa ahodoɔ nyinaa a wɔte asase nyinaa soɔ: Ɛnsi mo yie mmoroso! 1
Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ a ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn ayɛ me no, ayɛ me fɛ sɛ mɛka makyerɛ.2
Sɛdeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ si soso fa!3
na n’anwanwadeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛsi yɛ den fa!
n’ahennie yɛ daa ahennie,
na ne tumi wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyi
Me Nebukadnessar mete me fie dwoodwoo na
na mesoo daeɛ bi a ɛyii me hu,
Enti mehyɛɛ mmara sɛ wɔmfa Babel anyansafoɔ mmra m’anim, na wɔmmɛkyerɛ me daeɛ no ase. 6
Ɛnna nkonyaayifoɔ, pɛadeahunufoɔ, Kaldeafoɔ ne nyankonnekyerɛfoɔ baeɛ, na meyii daeɛ no kyerɛɛ wɔn, nanso wɔantumi ankyerɛ me aseɛ.
Na akyire yi no Daniel a wɔfrɛ
Beltesasar nkonyaayifoɔ panin sɛ menim
Na m’anisoadeɛ a mehunuu no me mpa soɔ no nie:10
Mehunuu dua bi sɛ ɛsi asase mfimfini,
a ɛw
Dua no nyini yɛɛ kɛseɛ na ɛyɛɛ den,11
na ne tentene kɔduruu soro,
na wɔhunu no asase so baabiara;
ɛso ahahan yɛ fɛ,12
na ɛso aba dɔɔso,
na aduane wɔ mu ma nnipa nyi
wiram mmoa tete ne nwunu ase,
na ewiem nnomaa sisi ne mman so,
na abɔdeɛ nyi
Mehunuu wɔ m’anisoadeɛ
Ɔteaa mu denden na ɔkaa sɛ:14
Mommu dua no ntwitwa ne mman.
Mompore n’ahahan mpansam n’aba;
mmoa nnwane mfiri aseɛ,
na nnomaa mfiri ne mman so.
Nanso monnya ne dunsini asase mu,15
dadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ mpokyerɛ mu,
petee so wira mu,
na ɔsoro bosuo mfɔ no,
na ɔne mmoa
nni asase so ahahan.
N’adwene nsakyera na anyɛ onipa deɛ bio,16
na wɔmma no aboa adwene
na mfeɛ nson ntwa ne tiri so.
Awɛmfoɔ kronkron yi agyina so na asɛm yi nam,17
na akronkronfoɔ asɛm so
deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ateasefoɔ ahunu sɛ:
Deɛ ɔwɔ ɔsorosoro na ɔdi nnipa ahennie so tumi,
na ɔde ma obiara a ɔpɛ,
na ɔde nnipa mu ahobrɛasefoɔ si soɔ.

Daeɛ yi na me, Ɔhene Nebukadnessar, mehunuiɛ. Na afei wo, Beltesasar, ka ne nkyerɛaseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ m’ahennie mu anyansafoɔ nyinaa ntumi nkyerɛ me aseɛ, na wo deɛ, ɛsiane sɛ anyame kronkron honhom wɔ wo mu nti, wobɛtumi.18
Ɛnna Daniel a ne din de Beltesasar no ho dwirii
Dua a wohunuiɛ
na n’ahahan yɛ fɛ
ɛne wo ɔhene a woso na woyɛ den
Na sɛ ɔhene hunuu ɔwɛmfoɔ kronkron bi
Ɔhene, nkyerɛaseɛ no nie, na ɔsorosoroni asotwe a ɛbɛba me wura ɔhene soɔ nie: 24
Wɔbɛtu wo afiri nnipa mu na
Na sɛdeɛ wɔkaa sɛ wɔnnya dua no dunsini
Enti ɔhene ma m’afotuo nyɛ wo fɛ na fa tenenee ka
Yeinom nyinaa baa Ɔhene Nebukadnessar so. 28
Abosome dummienu wiee duro no, da bi na ɔnenam Babel ahennie aban so; 29
ɔhene no kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ Babel kɛseɛ a makyekyere mayɛ ahennie gyinabea, me tumi denyɛ so na m’animuonyam agye no ni anaa?
Asɛm no da so wɔ ɔhene anomu
Na wɔbɛpamo wo afiri nnipa mu na
Dɔn no mu ara na asɛm
Na nna no akyiri
na mehyiraa Ɔsorosoroni no,
na mekamfoo deɛ ɔte ase daa no meyii no ayɛ,
sɛ ne tumi yɛ daa tumi
na n’ahennie wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyi

Awurade, hwan na wagye yɛn kaseɛ adie,
na hwan

na wɔamfa wɔn akoma ante aseɛ,
na mansa wɔn yadeɛ.
Yesaia kaa yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhunuu n’animuonyam, na ne ho asɛm na ɔkaeɛ.

ɛfiri sɛ na wɔpɛ nnipa animuonyam sene Nyankopɔn animuonyam.43

Maba wiase sɛ hann, na obiara a ɔgye me die no antena sum mu.
Na sɛ obi te me nsɛm na wannye anni a
Deɛ ɔmmu me na ɔnnye
ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ ɛnyɛ
Na menim sɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ no yɛ daa nkwa Enti deɛ meka
Na Twam afahyɛ no rebɛduru
Na wɔrebɛdidie no, na ɔbonsam anya de ahyɛ Yuda Iskariot, Simon ba, akoma mu sɛ ɔnkɔyi no mma.
Na Yesu nim sɛ Agya no de nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ ne nsa, ɛne sɛ ɔfirii Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na ɔrekɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn nti,
ɔsɔre firii adidiiɛ na ɔyii n’atadeɛ guu hɔ
Na afei ɔhwiee nsuo guu dwaresɛn mu, na ɔfirii aseɛ hohoroo asuafoɔ no nan ho, na ɔde mpepaho a ɔde kyekyeree ne ho no pepaa ho. 5
Ɛnna ɔbɛduruu Simon Petro soɔ; na ɔno deɛ, ɔsee no sɛ: Awurade, wo na worehohoro me nan ho yi? 6

Petro see no sɛ Meremma wo nhohoro me nan ho da! Yesu buaa
Simon Petro see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛnyɛ me nan ho nko, na me nsa ne me tirim nso bi. 9
Yesu see no sɛ Deɛ wadwareɛ
Na ɔnim deɛ ɔbɛyi no ama; yei nti na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mo nyinaa na mo ho afire no.11
Ɛnna ɔwiee wɔn nan ho hohorɔ na ɔfaa n’atadeɛ
Mo deɛ, mofrɛ me Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne Awurade, na moka nokorɛ, na meyɛ.
Afei sɛ me, Awurade ne Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no, mahohoro mo nan ho a, na ɛsɛ sɛ mo nso mohohoro mo ho mo ho nan ho.
Na mama mo nhwɛsoɔ sɛ sɛdeɛ mayɛ
Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Akoa nsene ne wura, na ɔsomafoɔ nsene deɛ ɔsomaa no.

Yesu kaa saa no ne ho yeraa
Ɛnna asuafoɔ no hwehwɛɛ wɔn ho anim, wɔnhunu onii korɔ a ɔne no. 22

Ɛnna ɔgyee paanoo sini no

Ahyɛdeɛ foforɔ na mema mo sɛ monnodɔ
Sɛ mododɔ mo ho a, ɛnam yei so nnipa nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ moyɛ m’asuafoɔ.

Mommma mo akoma nntutu! Monnye Onyankopɔn nni, na me nso, monnye me nni.
Tenaberɛ pii wɔ m’Agya fie; sɛ ɛnte saa a, anka maka makyerɛ mo sɛ merekɔ makɔsiesie baabi mama mo?
Na sɛ mekɔ na mekɔsiesie baabi mema mo a mɛba bio
Na faako a merekorɔ no, monim kwan no.
Toma see no sɛ: Awurade, yɛnnim faako a worekorɔ, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛbɛtumi ahunu kwan no? 5
Yesu see no sɛ Mene kwan
Sɛ monim me a, anka moahunu m’Agya no nso; na ɛfiri nnɛ monim no, na moahu no.
Filipo see no sɛ Awurade kyerɛ yɛn Agya
Yesu see no sɛ Me ne mo wɔ hɔ dadadada yi monhunuu me anaa Filipo? Deɛ wahu
Wonnye nni sɛ mewɔ Agya no mu na
Monnye me nni sɛ mewɔ Agya no mu na
Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ Deɛ ɔgye me die no nnwuma a meyɛ
Na biribiara a mobɛsrɛ no me din mu
Sɛ mobɛsrɛ biribi me din mu a, me deɛ, mɛyɛ.
Sɛ modɔ me a, monni m’ahyɛdeɛ so!
Na me deɛ, mɛbisa Agya no, na wama mo Okyigyinafoɔ foforɔ, na ɔne mo abɛtena daa,
nokorɛ Honhom a wiase ntumi nnye no
Merennya mo nnyanka, mɛba mo nkyɛn.
Aka kakra na wiase nhu me bio
Da no ara mobɛhunu sɛ mewɔ m’Agya
Deɛ ɔwɔ m’ahyɛdeɛ na ɔdi soɔ no ɔno ne deɛ ɔdɔ me
Yuda (ɛnyɛ Iskariot no) see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛyɛɛ dɛn na worebɛyi wo ho akyerɛ yɛn, na ɛnyɛ wiase? 22
Yesu bua see no sɛ Sɛ obi dɔ me a ɔbɛdi m’asɛm so na m’Agya bɛdɔ
Deɛ ɔnnɔ me no nni
Mewɔ mo nkyɛn yi, na mereka mo yeinom;
na Okyigyi
Asomdwoeɛ na mede megya mo m’asomdwoeɛ

Nanso meyɛ sɛdeɛ Agya no hyɛɛ me
Mene nokorɛ bobe no, na m’Agya ne okuafoɔ no.
Me ho ban biara a ɛnso aba no ɔyi na ebiara
Asɛm a maka makyerɛ mo no nti, mo ho anya afi.

Mene bobe no mone mman
Sɛ obi antena me mu a, wɔto no twene sɛ ban, na ɛwu; na wɔboaboa ano de kɔgu gya mu, na ɛhye.
Sɛ motena me mu na
Yei mu na wɔahyɛ m’Agya animuonyam, sɛ moso aba pii; ɛno na mobɛyɛ m’asuafoɔ.
Sɛdeɛ Agya no adɔ me
Sɛ modi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, mobɛtena me dɔ mu, sɛdeɛ madi m’Agya ahyɛdeɛ soɔ na mete ne dɔ mu no.
Maka yeinom nyinaa makyerɛ mo na m’anigyeɛ atena
Yei ne m’ahyɛdeɛ, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho sɛdeɛ medɔɔ mo no.
Obi nni dɔ kɛseɛ a ɛsene yei, sɛ obi de ne nkwa bɛto hɔ ama ne nnamfo.
Sɛ moyɛ deɛ mehyɛ mo a, na moyɛ me nnamfo.
Memfrɛ mo nkoa bio ɛfiri sɛ akoa nnim deɛ ne wura reyɛ na mafrɛ
Ɛnyɛ mo na moayi me
Yei na mehyɛ mo, sɛ monnodɔ mo ho.
Sɛ wiase tane mo a, monhunu sɛ watane me kane ansa na ɛretane mo.
Sɛ mofiri wiase a anka
Monkae asɛm a meka mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ Akoa nsene ne wura Sɛ wɔataa me
Na yeinom nyinaa, me din nti na wɔde bɛyɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnim deɛ ɔsomaa me no.
Sɛ mamma mammɛka mankyerɛ wɔn a, anka wɔnni bɔne; na afei deɛ, wɔnni wɔn bɔne ho anoyie.
Deɛ ɔtane me no tane m’Agya no nso.
Sɛ manyɛ nnwuma a obiara nyɛɛ da wɔ wɔn mu
Na ɛyɛɛ hɔ, na asɛm a wɔatwerɛ no wɔn mmara mu no aba mu sɛ: Wɔtane me kwa.
Na Okyigyinafoɔ a mɛsoma no mabrɛ mo afiri Agya
na mo nso mobɛdi adanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moka me ho firi mfitiaseɛ.
Yeinom na maka makyerɛ mo na moansunti.
Wɔbɛtu mo afiri hyia adan mu; mpo ɛberɛ reba a obiara a ɔbɛkum mo bɛsusu sɛ ɔde resom Onyankopɔn.
Na wɔbɛyɛ yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnya nhunuu Agya no ne me.
Na maka yeinom makyerɛ mo, na sɛ ɛberɛ no duru a, moakae sɛ maka makyerɛ mo.
Na manka mo yeinom mamfiri mfitiaseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ me ne mo na na ɛwɔ hɔ.
Na afei deɛ merekɔ
Na sɛ maka yeinom makyerɛ mo nti, awerɛhoɔ ahyɛ mo akoma ma.
Na meka mo nokorɛ; ɛyɛ ma mo sɛ mekorɔ.
Na ɔno deɛ, sɛ ɔba a, ɔbɛyi wiase atɛn bɔne ne tenenee ne atemmuo ho.
Bɔne ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnye me nni;
ne te
ne atemmuo ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔabu wiase sodifoɔ no atɛn.
Mewɔ nsɛm pii meka mekyerɛ mo, nanso montumi nsoa seesei.
Na sɛ ɔno, nokorɛ Honhom no, nya ba a, ɔbɛkyerɛ mo kwan akɔ nokorɛ no nyinaa mu.
Ɔno na ɔbɛhyɛ me animuonyam ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛfa
Nnoɔma a m’Agya wɔ nyinaa yɛ me dea; yei nti na mekaa sɛ: Ɔbɛfa me deɛ bi na ɔde abɛkyerɛ mo.

Ɛnna Yesu hunuu sɛ wɔrepɛ abisa no na ɔsee wɔn
Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ Mobɛsu na moatwa adwo
Ɔbaa sɛ ɔrewo a ɔte yea ɛfiri
Na mo nso seesei deɛ mowɔ awerɛhoɔ na mɛhu
na da no moremmisa me biribiara. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Biribiara a mobɛsrɛ Agya no me din mu no, ɔde bɛma mo.
Ɛde bɛduru sɛsɛɛ deɛ, monsrɛɛ biribi me din mu; monsrɛ, na mobɛnya, na mo anigyeɛ awie pɛyɛ.

Da no na mobɛsrɛ wɔ me din mu
na Agya no ara dɔ mo, ɛfiri sɛ modɔ me,

Yeinom na maka mo
Yeinom na Yesu kaeɛ
sɛdeɛ womaa no honam nyinaa so tumi, sɛ adeɛ biara a wɔde ama no no, ɔmma wɔn daa nkwa.
Na yei ne daa nkwa, sɛ wɔbɛhu wo, nokorɛ Nyankopɔn koro no, ne deɛ wosomaa no no, Yesu Kristo no.
Me deɛ, mahyɛ wo animuonyam asase so; mawie adwuma a wode maa me sɛ menyɛ no.
Na afei, Agya, fa animuonyam a mewɔ no wo nkyɛn ansa na wɔbɔɔ wiase no hyɛ me wo ara wo nkyɛn!
Mayi wo din adi makyerɛ nnipa a wode wɔn firi wiase ama me no. Wɔyɛ wo dea, na wode wɔn ama me; na wɔadi w’asɛm so.
Afei wɔahunu sɛ nnoɔma a wode ama me no nyinaa firi wo nkyɛn;
ɛfiri sɛ nsɛm a wode ama me no mede mama wɔn na
Me deɛ meresrɛ mama wɔn mensrɛ memma wiase na mmom
Na m’adeɛ nyinaa yɛ wo dea na
Na afei menni wiase bio — na yeinom
Mewɔ wɔn nkyɛn no mede

Mede w’asɛm mama wɔn na wiase atane
Mensrɛ sɛ Yi wɔn firi wiase na mmom
Wɔmfiri wiase, sɛdeɛ me nso memfiri wiase no.
Yɛ wɔn kronkron wɔ nokorɛ mu; w’asɛm yɛ nokorɛ.
Sɛdeɛ wosomaa me wiase no, saa ara na me nso meresoma wɔn wiase.
Na meyɛ me ho kronkron mema wɔn, na wɔn nso ayɛ kronkron nokorɛ mu.
Na ɛnyɛ yeinom nkutoo nti na mesrɛ
sɛ wɔn nyinaa nyɛ baako,
Na mede animuonyam a wode ama me no mama wɔn, sɛ wɔnyɛ baako, sɛdeɛ yɛyɛ baako no.

Agya wɔn a wɔde
Agya Tenenee wiase anhu wo na me deɛ mahu
na mayi wo din makyerɛ wɔn,

Na Yuda nso a ɔyii no maeɛ

Ɛnna Yesu a ɔnim deɛ ɛreba ne so nyinaa no firii adie, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Morehwehwɛ hwan?Morehwehwɛ hwan?

Ɛnna ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Meni!Meni! no, wɔpimpinii akyire, na wɔhwehwee ase. 6
Ɛnna ɔbisaa wɔn bio sɛ: Morehwehwɛ hwan?Morehwehwɛ hwan? Na wɔse: Yesu, Nasareni no. 7

Sɛ asɛm a ɔkaa sɛ Wɔn
Ɛnna Simon Petro a ɔkura nkrantɛ no tweeɛ na ɔde bɔɔ ɔsɔfo panin

na wɔde no kɔɔ Ha
Nso Kaiafa no ne deɛ ɔtuu Yudafoɔ
Na Simon Petro ne osuani baako bi dii Yesu akyi; nso ɔsɔfo panin no nim osuani no, na ɔne Yesu hyɛnee ɔsɔfo panin no aban mu hɔ. 15

Ɛnna abaawa a ɔhwɛ pono no ano
Nso na nkoa ne asomfoɔ no gyinagyina hɔ asɔ gya, ɛfiri sɛ awɔ aba, na wɔretoɔ; na Petro nso ne wɔn gyina hɔ na ɔreto bie.18

Yesu buaa no sɛ Me deɛ mekasaa pefee mekyerɛɛ wiase daa mekyerɛkyerɛɛ hyia adan mu ne asɔrefie faako a Yudafoɔ nyinaa
Adɛn na wobisa me? Bisa wɔn a wɔteeɛ no, ne deɛ mesee wɔn; hwɛ, wɔn na wɔnim deɛ mekaeɛ.
Na ɔkaa saa no asomfoɔ
Yesu buaa no sɛ Sɛ maka
Hana maa wɔde homa kyekyeree no kɔmaa Ɔsɔfopanin Kaiafa.24
Na Simon Petro gyina hɔ reto gya. Ɛnna wɔsee no sɛ: Wo nso, womfiri n’asuafoɔ no mu anaa? Ɔsanee sɛ: Dabi! 25
Ɔsɔfo panin no nkoa
Ɛnna Petro sanee bio, na ntɛm ara akokɔ bɔnee.27
Ɛnna wɔde Yesu firi Kaiafa nkyɛn kɔɔ amrado aban mu; na ɛyɛ anɔpatutu. Na wɔn ara deɛ, wɔanhyɛne amrado aban no mu, na efi anka wɔn, na wɔadi Twam (aduane) no. 28
Ɛnna Pilato firii adi baa wɔn nkyɛn, na ɔbisaa sɛ: Kwaadu bɛn na mobɔ tia saa onipa yi? 29
Wɔbua see no sɛ: Sɛ oyi nyɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni a, anka yɛamfa no ammrɛ wo. 30
Ɛnna Pilato see wɔn sɛ: Mo ara momfa no, na monkɔbu no atɛn sɛdeɛ mo mmara teɛ.
(Ɛbaa saa no, na Yesu asɛm a ɔka de kyerɛɛ owu korɔ a ɔrebɛwuo no aba mu.)32
Ɛnna Pilato hyɛnee amrado aban no mu bio, na ɔfrɛɛ Yesu bisaa no sɛ: Wone Yudafoɔ hene no anaa? 33
Yesu buaa no sɛ Ɛfiri wo ara
Pilato buaa no sɛ: Meyɛ Yudani anaa? Wo ara wo manfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no na wɔde wo brɛɛ me; ɛdeɛn na woyɛeɛ? 35
Yesu buaa sɛ M’ahennie mfiri wiase Sɛ m’ahennie firi
Ɛnna Pilato see no sɛ Na woyɛ ɔhene ne no? Yesu buaa
Pilato see no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne nokorɛ?38
Na ɔkaa yei no ɔfirii adi kɔɔ Yudafoɔ
Nso mowɔ amanneɛ sɛ megyaa ɔbaako mema mo Twam da mu; enti mopɛ sɛ megyaa Yudafoɔ hene no mema mo anaa? 39
Ɛnna wɔn nyinaa teaa mu bio sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi, na mmom Baraba! Nso Baraba yɛ odwotwafoɔ.40
Ɛnna afei Pilato faa Yesu, na ɔkaa no mpire. 1
Na asraafoɔ no nwonoo nkasɛɛ abotire, na wɔde hyɛɛ ne ti, na wɔde ntoma kɔkɔɔ bi guguu ne so, 2
na wɔkɔɔ so ara baa ne nkyɛn kaa sɛ: Yudafoɔ hene, mo oo! Na wɔbobɔɔ no asotorɔ.3
Ɛnna Pilato firii adi baa bio, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Hwɛ, mede no rebrɛ mo, na moahunu sɛ menhunu ne mu afobusɛm biara. 4
Ɛnna Yesu firii adi baeɛ, na ɔbɔ nkasɛɛ abotire, hyɛ atadeɛ kɔkɔɔ no. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Hwɛ, onipa no nie! 5
Ɛnna asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne asomfoɔ no hunuu
Yudafoɔ no buaa
Ɛnna Pilato tee asɛm yi no, ɔsuroo pii, 8
na ɔhyɛnee amrado aban no mu bio,
Ɛnna Pilato see no sɛ Wo ne me nkasa? Wonnim
Yesu buaa sɛ Sɛ wɔamfa amma wo amfiri soro a anka wonni me so tumi biara yei nti deɛ ɔyii
Ɛfiri hɔ no Pilato hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔgyaa
Na Pilato tee saa asɛm no, ɔde Yesu firii adi, na ɔbɛtenaa atemmuo adwa so baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ sɛ Abo-sɛeɛ, na Hebri mu wɔfrɛ no Gabata. 13
Na ɛyɛ Twam ho nsiesie da, na ɛbɛyɛ awia dummienu.
Na wɔteaa mu sɛ Fa no kɔ!
Ɛno na afei ɔyii no maa wɔn hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnkɔbɔ no asɛnnua mu.16
Na wɔfaa Yesu de no kɔeɛ.
Na ɔso n’asɛnnua firii adi kɔduruu baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Tikwankoraabea a Hebri mu wɔfrɛ no Golgota. 17
Ɛhɔ na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu, a nnipa baanu ka ne ho n’afanu, na Yesu wɔ wɔn ntam. 18

Na ne mmammarima no kɔto pono wɔ ɔbaako biara fie obiara
Na apontoɔ nna no fa wɔn so hyia a Hiob soma kɔdwira
Na ɛbaa sɛ da bi Ɔsoro dɔm
Na AWURADE bisaa Satan sɛ: Ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ yi?
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Woadwene m’akoa Hiob nso ho?
Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Ɛnyɛ biribi nti na Hiob suro Onyankopɔn no anaa?
Ɛnyɛ wo na woabɔ ɔno ne
Ɛnneɛ afei tene wo nsa ka deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hwɛ ɛ, sɛ ɔrennome wo ntɛm ara anaa! 11
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Hwɛ, deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa wɔ wo nsam, ɔno ara deɛ, mfa wo nsa nka no. Ɛnna Satan firii AWURADE anim kɔeɛ.12
Na da bi na Hiob mmammarima ne
Na ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Hiob nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Berɛ a anantwie no refɛntɛm na mfunumu bereɛ no nso redidi wɔn nkyɛn mu, 14
ɛnna Sabafoɔ bɛto hyɛɛ wɔn so na wɔafa
Ɔno da so rekasa no, ɔfoforɔ ba bɛkaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn gya firi soro atɔ abɛhye nnwan ne mmeranteɛ no, na asɛe wɔn, na me nko ara na mafiri mu maba sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. 16
Ɔno da so rekasa no obi ba bɛkaa sɛ Kaldeafoɔ abɔ kyenku mmiɛnsa abɛto ahyɛ yoma
Ɔno nso da so rekasa no, ɔfoforɔ ba bɛkaa sɛ: Wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom nsa wɔ wɔn nua panin fie no, 18
hwɛ mframa kɛseɛ firi ɛserɛ so aba abɛbɔ ɛdan no ntwea nnan
Ɛnna Hiob sɔre sunsuanee n’atadeɛ mu, na ɔyii ne ti, na ɔhwee fam sɔree Onyankopɔn, 20
na ɔkaa sɛ: Adagya
Yei nyinaa mu no, Hiob anyɛ bɔne sɛ ɔbɛbɔ Onyankopɔn soboɔ.22
Me nkwa yɛ me kra nwunu,1
mɛgyaa m’apinisie mu wɔ me mu,
mɛkasa m’awerɛhoɔ mu.
Mɛse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Mmu me fɔ,2
ma menhunu adekodeɛ a enti wo ne me ham yi.
Ɛyɛ ma wo sɛ wohyɛ obi soɔ anaa,3
sɛ wopo wo nsa ano adwuma
na wopene abɔnefoɔ agyi
Wowɔ honam aniwa4
anaasɛ wohunu adeɛ sɛ ɔdasani hu no?
Wo nna te sɛ ɔdasani nna5
anaa wo mfeɛ te sɛ onipa nna
Sɛ wohwehwɛ me mfomsoɔ akyiri kwan6
na wodi me bɔne akyire?
Nanso wonim sɛ menyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ,7
na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye wo nsam.
Wo nsa na ɛnwonoo me na ɛyɛɛ me,8
me nipa mu nyinaa prɛko, ɛnna woa
Kae sɛ wonwonoo me sɛ anwommoɔ,9
na wobɛma madane mfuturo bio a
Anaa woanhwie me angu sɛ nufosuo na womaa mepii sɛ nufosuo a akyenkyen ɛtoa?10
Wode wedeɛ ne nam na ɛhyɛɛ me,11
na wode nnompe ne ntini wurawuraa me mu.
Nkwa ne adɔeɛ na wode ayɛ me,12
na wo hwɛ nso wɛn me honhom.
Na yeinom na wode siee w’akomam;13
na mahunu sɛ yei
Sɛ meyɛ bɔne a, wobɛhwɛ me,14
na woremmu me bem
Sɛ medi abɔnefosɛm a, mennue,15
na sɛ metene nso a, meremma me tiri so;
ɛfiri sɛ ahohora ahyɛ me ma,
na mehwɛ m’amanehunu.
Na sɛ mema me ho so a, wobɛti me sɛ gyata16
na woasane ne me adi anwanwasɛm.
Na wode w’adansefoɔ afoforɔ ara abɛgyina m’anim,17
na woama w’abufuo adɔɔso me so,
na ɛdɔm a ɛto dɔm agu me so.
Adɛn nti na woyii me firii yafunu mu?18
Anka menya megyaa mu na ani biara anhu me ɛ!
Sɛ menya meyɛɛ sɛ adeɛ a ɛnni hɔ ɛ!19
Mefirii yafunu mu no, ɛnna anka wɔkɔgyaa me ɛda mu ɛ!
Me nna nyɛ kakraa bi?20
Ma no nnyaa me ɔnyi n’ani mfiri
ansa na makɔ deɛ merensane memma,21
na makɔ sum ne sunsum asase so,
esum kabii a ɛte sɛ ɔdasuom tumm asase,22
sunsum ne sakasaka asase a hann te sɛ ɔdasuom tumm no.
Ɛnna Naamani Sofar gyee so sɛ:1
Wɔremmua nsɛm dodoɔ yi,2
anaasɛ wɔmma ɔbarima tɛkyerɛmakyene nni bem anaa?
Wo kasa worɔworɔ bɛma nnipa amua wɔn ano anaa?3
Na sɛ wodi fɛw a, obi renhyɛ wo aniwuo anaa?
Na woaka sɛ: Me nkyerɛkyerɛ yɛ gyenegyene,4
na me ho te wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
O, anka ma Onyankopɔn nkasa5
na ɔmmue n’ano nkyerɛ wo;
na ɔnka wo nyansa ahuntasɛm, sɛ emu dɔ yie,6
na hunu sɛ Onyankopɔn yi n’ani firi w’amumuyɛ no bi so.
Wobɛhwehwɛ ahunu Onyankopɔn7
anaasɛ wobɛhunu akɔduru Otumfoɔ pɛyɛ mu anaa?
Ɛkorɔn sɛ ɔsoro, — ɛdeɛn na wobɛyɛ?8
Ɛyɛ kuronkuron sɛ Asamando, — ɛdeɛn na wonim?
Ne nsusuiɛ ware sene asase,9
na ɛtrɛ sene ɛpo.
Sɛ ɔtwam ba na ɔde nnipa gu nnua mu na ɔhyia asennie a,10
ɛnneɛ hwan na ɔbɛsianka no?
Na ɔno na ɔnim nnipa ahuhufoɔ,11
na ɔhunu abusudeɛ,
Na onipa tibɔnkɔso nya nyansa akoma a,12
na ɛte sɛdeɛ wɔawo afunumu ba onipa.
Sɛ wo deɛ, wosiesie w’akoma,13
na wotrɛ wo nsam kyerɛ no a,
sɛ amumuyɛ wɔ wo nsam a, yi kɔ akyiri,14
na mma abusudeɛ nnte
Ɛno na wobɛma w’ani so a wonni dɛm,15
na wobɛtim pintinn a worensuro.
Na wo werɛ bɛfiri wo haw,16
wobɛkae no sɛ nsuo a asene.
Na wo nkwa nna bɛyɛ sɛ awia ketee,17
esum bɛdane sɛ adekyeeɛ.
Na wobɛnya abotɔyam sɛ anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ,18
na wobɛhwɛ wo ho ahyia
Wobɛda ahome, na obi renyi wo hu,19
na nnipa bebree bɛhwehwɛ wo hɔ adom.
Na abɔnefoɔ deɛ wɔn ani so bɛsi20
na dwanekɔbea abɔ wɔn,
na wɔn anidasoɔ bɛdane wɔn wuo.
Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:1
Yoo! Mone ɔman no nne,2
na mowu a, nyansa bɛwu.
Me nso, mewɔ nteaseɛ sɛ mo ara,3
me deɛ,
Na hwan na ɔnnim nnoɔma a ɛte sɛɛ yi?
Deɛ ne yɔnko sere no ne me,4
deɛ ɔsu frɛɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔgyee no soɔ,
wɔsere ɔteneneeni a ɔdi mu no.
Deɛ ɔte hɔ dwoodwoo no tirim deɛ, animtiabuo na ɛfata amanehunu,5
ɛne deɛ wasiesie ama wɔn a wɔn nan watirie.
Amimfoɔ ntomadan si hɔ dwoodwoo,6
na wɔn a wɔhuru Nyankopɔn boɔ te hɔ komm,
wɔn a wɔkura
Na yei deɛ, bisa mmoa ɛ, na wɔnkyerɛ wo,7
ne ɔsoro nnomaa nso, na wɔnka nkyerɛ wo.
Anaasɛ bisa asase hwɛ, na ɛnkyerɛ wo,8
na ɛpo mu mpataa nka nkyerɛ wo.
Hwan na ɔrenhunu yei nyinaa mu9
sɛ AWURADE nsa na ɛyɛɛ yeinom?
Ne nsam na ɔteasefoɔ biara kra wɔ,10
ne adasamma nyinaa ahonhom.
Ɛnyɛ aso na ɛsɔ nsɛm hwɛ,11
na dodom nso ka aduane hwɛ?
Nkɔkoraayɛ mu na nyansa wɔ,12
na onyinkyerɛ ma nhunumu.
Ɔno nkyɛn na nyansa ne mmaninneɛ wɔ,13
ɔno na afotuo ne nhunumu wɔ no.
Hwɛ, ɔdwiri, na wɔrento,14
ɔto onipa mu, na wɔremmue.
Hwɛ, ɔsianka nsuo ma no we,15
nanso ɔgyaa mu ma no butu asase.
Ɔno nkyɛn na ahoɔden ne nyansa wɔ,16
deɛ wɔdaadaa no ne ɔdaadaafoɔ nyinaa yɛ ne dea.
Ɔpa apamfoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ,17
na ɔma atemmufoɔ dane nkwaseafoɔ;
ɔsane ahemfo nkyehoma,18
na ɔde nhoma kyekyere wɔn asene.
Ɔpa asɔfoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ,19
na ɔde wɔn a wɔatim no hwe fam;
ɔma anotefoɔ gyae kasa20
na ɔgye mpanimfoɔ nimdeɛ;
ɔde animtiabuo gu mmapɔmma so,21
na ɔhodwo nnɔmmarima abɔsoɔ mu.
Ɔyi adeɛ kuronkuron adi firi sum mu;22
na ɔde sum kabii firi ba hann mu;
ɔma aman dɔɔso, na ɔsɛe wɔn;23
ɔtrɛ amanaman mu, na ɔtu wɔn kɔ,
ɔgye asase so aman mu atitire akoma.24
Na ɔma wɔkyini asasesofoɔ a ɔkwan nni hɔ so.
Wɔkeka sum a hann nni hɔ mu,25
na ɔma wɔkyini sɛ nsaboni.
Hwɛ, m’ani ahunu ne nyinaa, m’aso nso ate, na ate aseɛ;1
deɛ monim no, me nso menim.2
Mentɔ mu wɔ mo mu.
Me deɛ, mepɛ sɛ anka me ne Otumfoɔ no mmom bɛkasa,3
na mehwehwɛ sɛ me ne Onyankopɔn bɛyiyi nsɛm ano.
Na mo deɛ, moyɛ atorofoɔ mapa,4
ayaresafoɔ ahuhufoɔ ne mo nyinaa.
Sɛ momua mo ano mmom koraa a,5
anka ɛyɛ mo nyansa.
Montie me nkurobɔ,6
na monyɛ aso mma m’anoyie.
Mobɛka deɛ ɛntene ama Onyankopɔn,7
na mode n
Mobɛgye ne ti,8
anaasɛ mobɛham ama Onyankopɔn?
Ɔhwehwɛ mo mu a, ɛbɛsi yie,9
anaasɛ mobɛdaadaa no sɛdeɛ wɔdaadaa ɔdasani?
Sɛ mohwɛ nnipa anim kokoa mu a,10
ɔbɛka mo anim ampa.
Ne kɛseyɛ rentu mo akoma,11
na ne ho hu mma mo so?
Mo kasammebuo yɛ nso mmebusɛm,12
mo anoyie yɛ dɔteɛ anoyie.
Mommua mo ano mfiri me so, na me ara menkasa,13
na deɛ ɛbɛba me soɔ mmra.
Adɛn nti na memfa me honam mentua me se ano,14
na memfa me kra mento me nsam?
Sɛ ɔreku me mpo a, mehwɛ ɔno ara;15
mede me nsɛm bɛto n’anim.
Yei ara nso na ɛbɛyɛ me nkwagyeɛ,16
ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ remma n’anim.
Montie, montie deɛ mewɔ meka,17
na m’asɛm nkyerɛaseɛ nhyɛne mo aso mu.
Hwɛ, masiesie m’asɛm mato hɔ,18
menim sɛ me na mɛdi bem.
Hwan ne deɛ ɔne me bɛham?19
Ɛnneɛ anka mɛyɛ komm na magyaa mu.
Ao! AWURADE, sɛ woreyɛ adeɛ mmienu yi pɛ ama me a,20
ɛno na meremfa me ho menhunta mfiri w’anim:
Yi wo nsa firi me so kɔ akyirikyiri,21
na mma wo ho hu nnkuta me;
ɛno na frɛ me
anaasɛ mɛkasa, na woabua me.
Me bɔne ne me mfomsoɔ yɛ ahe ara?23
Ma menhunu me mmarato ne me bɔne.
Adɛn nti na wode w’ani hunta,24
na wobu me wo tamfo?
Wobɛyi ahahan a mframa de rekorɔ ahi,25
na wobɛti nkraadua a adwan?
Na wotwerɛɛ me ho nsɛm yaya,26
na woma medi me mmeranteberɛ mu bɔne so adeɛ.
Wode me nan hyehyɛ ɛpa mu,27
na wowɛn m’akwan nyi
wotwa m’anammɔn ho hyeɛ.
Na onipa deɛ, ɔporɔ sɛ dufɔkyeɛ,28
sɛ ntoma a nweweboaa redie.
Onipa a ɔbaa awo no,1
ne nna yɛ tiaa bi,
na ɔhaw ma.
Ɔpue sɛ nhwiren, na wɔtwa.2
Ɔdwane sɛ sunsum, na ɔnnyina.
Na yei so na woabue w’ani,3
na wode me rekɔ atemmuo mu w’anim?
Hwan na ɔbɛnya ɔhoteni, wɔn a wɔn ho akum no mu?4
Obiara nni hɔ.
Sɛ wɔahyɛ me nna ato hɔ,5
na n’abosome dodoɔ wɔ wo tirim,
na woatwa hyeɛ a ɔrensiane ho ama no a,
ɛnneɛ yi w’ani firi ne so6
na ɔnhome nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwie ne da sɛ ɔpaani.
Na dua mpo, anidasoɔ wɔ hɔ ma no,7
sɛ wɔtwa a, ɛbɛfefɛ,
na ne nnubaa remmɔ no:
Sɛ ne nhini kyenkyen ɛfam,8
na ne dunsini wu dɔteɛ mu a,
nsuo hwa nti ɛfefɛ,9
na ɛyiyi mman sɛ dua a wɔatɛ.
Na ɔdasani deɛ, ɔwu,10
na ɔbea hɔ,
Na sɛdeɛ nsuo firi ɔtadeɛ mu na ɛdɔ mpumpunadeɛ,11
na asuo nso mem
saa ara na onipa kɔda hɔ, na ɔnsɔreɛ.12
Ɔsoro nnya ntwaa mu yi, wɔrennyane,
na wɔrempusu wɔn mfiri wɔn n
O, sɛ wode me resie Asamando ɛ,13
sɛ wode me rehunta akɔsi
sɛ wohyɛ me da na wokae me ɛ!
Sɛ onipa wu a, ɔbɛtena ase bio anaa?14
Anka m’akodie nna nyinaa mɛtwɛn
akɔsi sɛ me nsakyera bɛba.
Anka wobɛfrɛ, na me nso magye wo so,15
anka w’ani bɛgyina wo nsa ano adwuma no.
Nanso afei deɛ, wokan m’anammɔn,16
na wonyi w’ani mfiri me bɔne so.
Wɔasɔ me mmarato ano de ahyɛ kotokuo mu,17
na woakyekyere me bɔne ano.
Ampa ara bepɔ mpo hwe ase yera,18
na ɔbotan nso twe firi n’afa.
Na sɛdeɛ aboɔ nso, nsuo hono no,19
na ne yire pra fam dɔteɛ kɔ,
saa ara na ɔdasani anidasoɔ nso woma no yera.
Wotintim ne so ma no twam kɔ,20
wosakyera n’anim na wosum no kɔ.
Ne mma nya animuonyam mpo a, ɔnnim,21
wɔbrɛ wɔn ase nso a, ɔnhunu mma wɔn.
Ɔno ara ne honam yea nko na ɔteɛ,22
na ne kra di ɔno ara ne ho abooboo.
Ɛnna Temanni Elifas buaa sɛ:1
Onyansafoɔ de nimdeɛ huuhuu bɛbua,2
na ɔde apueeɛ mframa ahyɛ n’afuru ma a
Ɔde nsɛm a ɛmfra bɛyi atɛn3
ne nsɛnkeka a mfasoɔ nni mu anaa?
Nso woto nyamesuro twene,4
na wosi Nyankopɔn anim nsusuiɛ ho kwan.
Na w’ano nsɛm kyerɛ wo bɔne,5
na woafa aniteɛ tɛkyerɛma.
Wo ara w’ano na ɛbu wo fɔ, na ɛnyɛ me,6
aane, wo ara ankasa w’ano na ɛdi adanseɛ tia woɔ.
Wone deɛ ɔdi kan a wɔwoo no onipa,7
na wɔnyinsɛn wo ansa
Wokɔtiee Nyankopɔn agyinatuo,8
na woasi nyansa ano afa?
Ɛdeɛn na wonim a yɛnnim,9
na wohunu mu a ɛnni yɛn nkyɛn?
Hwɛ, wafu dwono ne akɔkoraa wɔ yɛn mu,10
deɛ ɔsene w’agya panin mpo.
Nyankopɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ ne n’asɛm11
a wɔne wok
Adɛn na w’akoma twe wo korɔ,12
na adɛn
na wodane wo honhom tia Onyankopɔn13
na woma nsɛnkeka firi w’anomu?
Hwan ne ɔdasani a ne ho bɛteɛ14
ne deɛ ɔbaa awo no a ɔte
Hwɛ, n’akronkronfoɔ so mpo ɔmfa ne ho nto,15
na ɔsoro ho nso nte n’ani so:
Na nkantom deɛ ne ho yɛ nwunu na waporɔ,16
onipa a ɔnom amumuyɛ sɛ nsuo!
Mɛkyerɛ wo, na tie me;17
na deɛ mahunu yi, mɛka akyerɛ wo.
Deɛ anyansafoɔ aka akyerɛ18
na wɔansi so firi wɔn agyanom berɛ soɔ;
wɔn nko na wɔde asase no maa
na ɔhɔhoɔ biara antwam wɔn mu.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ ho yera no, ne nna nyinaa,20
na wɔde mfeɛ a wɔakan asie otirimuɔdenfoɔ.
Ehu nkateɛ gyegye n’aso mu,21
asomdwoeɛ mpo mu na ɔsɛefoɔ ba ne soɔ.
Ɔnnye nni sɛ ɔbɛsane afiri sum mu,22
na wɔayi no ama afe
Ɔkyini hwehwɛ aduane, ka sɛ: Ɛhe na ɛwɔ?23
Ɔnim sɛ esum da abɛn no.
Ahohiahia ne ahokyere yi no hu,24
ɛtintim no sɛ ɔhene a wasiesie ne ho ama ɔko a ɛyɛ hu.
Ɛfiri sɛ watene ne nsa atia Onyankopɔn,25
na wate Otumfoɔ so atua.
Ɔde kɔn a asene ato aba ne so,26
ne n’akyɛm akyi apɔapɔ a emu yɛ duro no;
ɛfiri sɛ wama ne sradeɛ akata n’anim,27
na wama ne mfe mu adɔre sradeɛ,
na wakɔte
afie a obi nte mu na wɔahyɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ afituo mu:
Ɔrennya ne ho, na n’adedodoɔ nso rennyina,29
na ne nnɔbaeɛ renkonkom mma fam;
Ɔremfiri sum mu mfi,30
ogyaframa bɛma ne nnuaban adwan,
na n’anomu mframa bɛpra ne nhyerɛne akɔ;
mma no mmfa ne ho nnto ahuhudeɛ so nnnaadaa ne ho,31
na ahuhudeɛ ara
Ne da nnya nnuruiɛ no na akatua no bɛba,32
na ne duban renyɛ frɔmfrɔm;
ɔbɛpore n’asia abunu sɛ obobe deɛ,33
na wawoso ne nhyerɛne agu sɛ ngodua deɛ;
na abɔnefoɔ fekuo bɛyɛ abonini,34
na ogya bɛhye adanmudegyeɛ ntomadan.
Wɔnyinsɛn ɔhaw, na wɔwo mmusuo,35
na wɔn yafunu siesie n
Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:1
Mate saa nsɛm a ɛte sɛɛ bebree;2
mo nyinaa
Nsɛnhuuhuu yi awieeɛ nie?3
Anaasɛ ɛdeɛn na ɛhwanyan wo ma wobua?
Sɛ mowɔ me tebea mu a,4
anka me nso mɛkasa sɛ mo,
anka mɛhɔre nsɛm magu mo so,
na mawoso me ti magu mo so;
aane, anka mede m’ano bɛhyɛ mo den,5
na m’anomu duema ama mo yea aboto.
Sɛ mekasa a, me yea no mmoto,6
na sɛ megyae nso a, ɛdeɛn
Na afei deɛ, Onyankopɔn ahodwo me;7
woama me ho nnipa nyinaa agu;
woapompono me ama no adane adanseɛ,8
na me fɔn asɔre atia
Wasunsuane me n’abufuo mu, na ɔtaa me;9
ɔtwɛre ne se gu me so.
M’ahohiahiafoɔ no pɔkyere n’ani hwɛ me.
Wɔhaahaa wɔn anomu tia me,10
wɔde ahohorabɔ bobɔ m’aso mu,
wɔn nyinaa boaboa
Onyankopɔn ayi me ahyɛ abusufoɔ nsa,11
na wasum me ato abɔnefoɔ nsam.
Anka medi yie, na ɔbubuu me.12
Ɔsɔɔ me kɔn na ɔbubuu me pasaa,
na ɔde me sii hɔ yɛɛ ne botaeɛ;
n’agyan dii me so ntwaguo,13
ɔpaee me sawa mu, na wannodo ho,
ɔhwiee me bɔnwoma guu fam;
