Sɛ yɛsii afɔrebukyia sɛ yɛresane afiri AWURADE akyi anaasɛ yɛrebɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa aduane afɔdeɛ anaasɛ yɛrebɔ so asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE mmɛbisa. 23
Na ɛyɛ suro ne asɛm bi nti na yɛyɛɛ saa ɛfiri sɛ yɛse Ɔkyena
Na ɛhyeɛ na AWURADE de Yordan yɛɛ no yɛn ne mo Rubenfoɔ
Enti na yɛkaa sɛ: Momma yɛnsi afɔrebukyia mfa, ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ na ɛnyɛ okum afɔdeɛ nti, 26
na mmom sɛ ɛnyɛ yɛn ne mo
Na yɛkaa sɛ:
Yei mpare yɛn sɛ yɛbɛte AWURADE anim atua na yɛadane
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Pinehas ne asafo no mmapɔmma
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas ka kyerɛɛ Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ
Ɛnna Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ba Pinehas ne mmapɔmma no sane wɔn akyiri firii Rubenfoɔ
Na asɛm no sɔɔ Israelfoɔ
Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ no too afɔrebukyia
Na AWURADE maa Israel home firii wɔn atamfoɔ a wɔatwa
Yosua frɛɛ Israel nyinaa wɔn mpanimfoɔ ne
Na mo nso moahunu deɛ AWURADE
Monhwɛ mede ntonto makyɛ amanaman a aka yi ne
Na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn no ɔno na ɔbɛsunsum wɔn afiri
Enti monhyɛ mo ho den pa ara, na monhwɛ nyɛ deɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara nwoma mu no nyinaa, na moammane amfiri ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum,
na moankɔ ama
na mmom AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ho
Na AWURADE atu amanaman akɛseɛ a wɔn ho yɛ den afiri mo anim, na mo deɛ, obi ntumi nnyinaa mo anim de abɛduru nnɛ.
Mo mu baako bɛpamo nnipa apem, na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔko ma mo, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no. 10
Enti monhwɛ mo ho yie, na monnɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. 11
Na sɛ mosane mo akyiri de
ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn renkɔ so ntu amanaman yi mfiri
Na hwɛ me deɛ ɛnnɛ merekɔ asase sofoɔ nyinaa kwan na monhunu mo akoma
Na sɛdeɛ asɛmpa a AWURADE kaa mo no nyinaa aba
Sɛ mofom AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn apam a ɔhyɛɛ
Na Yosua boaboaa Israel mmusuakuo no nyinaa ano baa Sekem na ɔfrɛɛ
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: Asuogya na mo agyanom, Abraham agya ne
Na mefaa mo agya Abraham firii asuogya, na memaa no nantee Kanaan asase nyinaa so, na memaa n’asefoɔ dɔree, na memaa no Isak. 3
Na Isak nso memaa no Yakob ne Esau na mede Seir bepɔ
Na mesomaa Mose ne Aaron, na mehaa Misraim, sɛdeɛ meyɛɛ no wɔ mu no, na akyire yi no meyii mo firii hɔ.
Na meyii mo agyanom firii Misraim no mobaa ɛpo
na wɔsu frɛɛ AWURADE,
Na mede mo baa Amorifoɔ a wɔte Yordan agya no asase so na wɔne
Ɛnna Moabhene Sipor ba Balak sɔre bɛnee Israel koeɛ, na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Beor ba Bileam sɛ ɔmmɛdome mo;
na mampene sɛ mɛtie Bileam,
Na motwaa Yordan baa Yeriko na Yerikofoɔ ne mo koe
Na mesomaa nkotokurodu dii mo anim maa wɔpamoo wɔn firii
Na memaa mo asase a woammrɛ ho ne nkuro
Na afei monsuro AWURADE na monsom no mudie ne nokorɛ mu
Na sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔ mo ani so
Na ɔman no gyee so sɛ: Yei mpare yɛn sɛ yɛbɛgya AWURADE hɔ akɔsom anyame foforɔ. 16
Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ne yɛn Nyankopɔn ɔno
Na AWURADE apamo aman no nyinaa ne Amorifoɔ a wɔte asase
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ Morentumi nsom AWURADE ɛfiri
Sɛ mogya AWURADE hɔ na mokɔsom ananafoɔ anyame a, ɔbɛdane ayɛ mo bɔne na wama moahye, sɛ ɔyɛɛ mo yie kane no. 20
Na ɔman no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Dabi, na AWURADE ara na yɛbɛsom no. 21
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Mo ara ne mo ho adansefoɔ sɛ mo ara moayi AWURADE afa sɛ mobɛsom no.
Na afei montoto amannɔne anyame a ɛwɔ mo mu no ngu, na monnanedane mo akoma mma AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔman no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn na yɛbɛsom no, na ne nne na yɛbɛtie. 24
Ɛnna Yosua ne ɔman no pam da
Na Yosua twerɛɛ nsɛm yi hyɛɛ Nyankopɔn mmara nwoma no mu, na ɔde ɔboɔ kokuroo sii hɔ wɔ odum dua a ɛsi AWURADE kronkronbea no ase.
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ Hwɛ ɔboɔ yi nni yɛn adanseɛ na ɛno
Ɛnna Yosua gyaa ɔman no kwan maa wɔn nyinaa kokɔɔ wɔn agyapadeɛ soɔ.28
Na nsɛm no akyiri
Na wɔsiee no n’agyapadeɛ mu, Timnat-sera a ɛwɔ Efraim bepɔ soɔ wɔ Gaas bepɔ atifi fam.30
Na Israel som AWURADE Yosua nna nyinaa ne
Na Yosef nnompe a Israelfoɔ de firii Misraim baeɛ no wɔkorae wɔ Sekem asase
Na Aaron ba Eleasa nso wui na wɔkoraa no ne
Ɛnna Yosua sɔree anɔpahema na wɔtu firii Sitim
Na nnansa wiee duro no ahwɛfoɔ
kɔhyɛɛ ɔman no sɛ Sɛ mohunu AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn apam adaka
nanso monsusu ɔkwan bɛyɛ sɛ basafa apem nto mo ne no ntam mommmɛn
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monte mo ho, na ɔkyena AWURADE bɛyɛ mo mu anwanwadeɛ.
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ asɔfoɔ no sɛ: Monsoa apam adaka no nsene nni ɔman no anim.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Ɛnnɛ da yi na mɛfiri aseɛ mayɛ wo kɛseɛ Israel nyinaa ani soɔ, na wɔahunu sɛ, sɛdeɛ medii Mose akyire no, saa ara na mɛdi w’akyire.
Na wo deɛ, hyɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso apam adaka no sɛ: Sɛ moduru Yordan nsuo no ano a, monnyina Yordan mu.8
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Israel mma no sɛ: Montwe mmra ha, na montie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nsɛm. 9
Ɛnna Yosua kaa sɛ Yei na mode bɛhunu
Hwɛ, asase nyinaa wura apam adaka no redi w’anim akɔ Yordan mu. 11
Na afei momfa mmarima dummienu mfiri Israel mmusuakuo no mu, abusuakuo biara mu nipa baako. 12
Na sɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso AWURADE asase nyinaa wura adaka no anammɔn ka Yordan nsuo
Na ɔman no tu firii wɔn ntomadan mu sɛ wɔrekɔtwa Yordan, na asɔfoɔ a wɔso apam adaka no dii ɔman no anim, 14
na wɔn a wɔso adaka no duruu Yordan ano,
ɛnna nsuo a ɛfiri atifi ba no gyina bɔɔ kuo baako wɔ akyirikyiri
Na asɔfoɔ a wɔso apam adaka no gyinaa asase pɛsɛɛ so Yordan mfimfini pintinn, na Israel nyinaa nam asase pɛsɛɛ so twa de kɔsii sɛ ɔman mu no nyinaa wiee Yordan twa.17
Na ɔman mu no nyinaa twaa Yordan wieeɛ no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: 1
Monyiyi ɔman no mu mmarima dummienu, abusuakuo biara mu onipa baako, 2
na monhyɛ wɔn sɛ: Montase aboɔ dummienu mfiri Yordan mfimfini ha mfiri deɛ asɔfoɔ no
Ɛnna Yosua frɛɛ mmarima dummienu a ɔyii wɔn firii Israelfoɔ mu no, abusuakuo biara mu onipa baako. 4

Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsene nni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn adaka no anim nkɔ Yordan mfimfini, na montase aboɔ mmaako mmaako mmobɔ mo kɔn ho, sɛdeɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no ano sie, na yei ayɛ mo mu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ. 5
Sɛ mo mma bisa
Monka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ Ɛkyerɛ
Na Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ saa sɛdeɛ Yosua hyɛeɛ
Na Yosua memaa aboɔ dummienu so sisii Yordan mu, deɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso apam adaka no nan sisiiɛ hɔ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.9
Na asɔfoɔ a wɔso adaka no gyinaa Yordan mu ara de kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee asɛm
Na ɔman no yɛɛ ntɛm twae.
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔman no nyinaa wiee twa
Na Ruben mma ne Gad
nnipa bɛyɛ mpemaduanan a wɔasiesie wɔn ho ama ɔko na ɛtwa dii AWURADE anim kɔɔ ɔsa, Yeriko mpaperɛ soɔ. 13
Da no ara na AWURADE pagyaa Yosua Israel nyinaa ani so
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: 15
Hyɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔso adanseɛ adaka no, na wɔmforo mfiri Yordan mu. 16
Na Yosua hyɛɛ asɔfoɔ no sɛ: Momforo mfiri Yordan mu. 17
Na asɔfoɔ a wɔso AWURADE apam adaka no foro firii Yordan mu na
Na ɔman no foro firii Yordan mu bosome a ɛdi kan
Na aboɔ dummienu a wɔtase firii Yordan mu no, Yosua de sisii Gilgal. 20
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔkyena bi mo mma bisa wɔn agyanom sɛ: Aboɔ yi kyerɛ deɛn?
Momma mo mma nhunu sɛ asase pɛsɛɛ so na Israel fa de twaa Yordan yi, 22
sɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn wee Yordan nsuo no mo anim kɔsii
na asase so aman nyi
Na Amorifoɔ ahene a wɔwɔ Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam no nyinaa ne Kanaan ahemfo
Saa berɛ no ara na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yɛ twerɛboɔ asekan, na sane twitwa Israelfoɔ no twetia a ɛtɔ so mmienu.
Na Yosua yɛɛ twerɛboɔ asekan de twitwaa Israelfoɔ no twetia Aaralot kokoɔ so. 3
Na deɛ enti a Yosua twitwaa wɔn twetia ne sɛ Ɔman no
Nanso ɔman no a wɔfiri Misraim firiiɛ
Mfirinhyia aduanan na Israelfoɔ no nantee ɛserɛ soɔ kɔsii sɛ akofoɔ a wɔfiri Misraim baeɛ
Na wɔn mma na ɔmaa wɔsɔre sii
Na wɔwiee ɔman mu no nyinaa twetiatwa
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Ɛnnɛ mamuni Misraim nsopa afiri mo so. Ɛno nti wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Gilgal
Na Israelfoɔ no kyeree nsraban Gilgal na wɔdii Twam
Na Twam no akyi adeɛ kyeeɛ
Na mana no to twae firi da a wɔdii asase
Na Yosua wɔ Yeriko ho no, ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi gyina ne ntentensoɔ kura nkrantɛ a watwe.
Na ɔse Dabi na afei
Na AWURADE dɔm so safohene no ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Yi wo mpaboa firi wo nan, na deɛ wogyina hɔ yɛ kronkron.
Na Yeriko deɛ na wɔato mu
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Hwɛ, mede Yeriko ne ne hene ne akofoɔ no mahyɛ wo nsa. 2
Na montwa kuro no ho nhyia akofoɔ
Na asɔfoɔ baason nkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nson mfa nni adaka no anim, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no, montwa kuro no ho nhyia mprɛnson, na asɔfoɔ no nhyɛne ntotorobɛnto no.
Na sɛ wɔhyɛne osebɔ abɛn no na mote totorobɛnto
Na Nun ba Yosua frɛfrɛɛ asɔfoɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsoa apam adaka no, na asɔfoɔ baason nkurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nni AWURADE adaka no anim. 6
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ Monsene nkɔtwa kuro
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no
Na wɔn a wɔamia no dii asɔfoɔ
Na ɔman no deɛ Yosua hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ Mommmɔ ose na mommma wɔnnte mo nne
Na AWURADE adaka no twaa kuro
Na Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na asɔfoɔ no soaa AWURADE adaka no. 12
Na asɔfoɔ baason no kurakura osebɔ ntotorobɛnto nson
Na da a ɛtɔ so mmienu no wɔtwaa kuro
Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no adeɛ rekye pɛ na wɔtuaa nhema sɔree ntɛm
Na ɛbaa sɛ deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no soɔ a asɔfoɔ
Na kuro no nyɛ ahyiradeɛ ɛno ne emu ade nyinaa mma AWURADE odwamamfoɔ Rahab nko ara na ɔnnya nkwa ɔno
Mo ho yie ara na monhwɛ ahyiradeɛ no
Na dwetɛ ne sika
Ɛnna ɔman no bɔɔ ose na wɔhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto
Na wɔde nkrantɛ ano sɛee deɛ ɛwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa pasapasa, mmarima ne mmaa, mmɔfra ne mpanin, anantwie ne nnwan ne mfunumu.21
Na mmarima baanu a wɔkɔsraa asase no deɛ Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ Monkɔ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ
Na mmeranteɛ akwansrafoɔ no kɔe na wɔde Rahab ne n’agya
Na kuro no deɛ wɔde ogya hyee ɛne
Na odwamamfoɔ Rahab ne n’agya fie
Na Yosua kaa ntam saa berɛ no sɛ:26
Nnome nka onipa a ɔbɛsɔre
abɛkyekyere Yeriko kuro yi, AWURADE anim:
Ɔde n’abakan na ɛbɛhyɛ aseɛ,
na ɔde ne ba akumaa
Na AWURADE dii Yosua akyi, na wɔtee ne nka asase no nyinaa so.27
Na Israelfoɔ no too ahyiradeɛ
Na Yosua somaa mmarima bi firi Yeriko kɔɔ Ai a ɛwɔ Bet-awen ho, Betel apueeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔsra asase no.
Na wɔsane baa Yosua nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ Mma ɔman
Na ɔman no mu bɛyɛ mpensa foro kɔɔ hɔ, nanso wɔdwane firii Ai mmarima no anim. 4
Na Ai mmarima no kunkumm wɔn mu nnipa bɛyɛ aduasa nsia na wɔtaa
Na Yosua sunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔde n’anim butuu fam, AWURADE adaka no anim de kɔsii anwummerɛ, ɔno ne Israel mpanimfoɔ, na wɔde dɔteɛ guguu wɔn atifi. 6
Na Yosua kaa sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn adɛn nti na wode ɔman yi twaa Yordan
Wo kyɛw nie, AWURADE, sɛ Israel adane wɔn akyi akyerɛ wɔn atamfoɔ yi, ɛdeɛn na menka? 8
Na Kanaanfoɔ ne asase yi sofoɔ nyinaa bɛte, na wɔabɛtwa yɛn ho ahyia, na wɔatwa yɛn din afiri asase so:
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Sɔre ɛ, adɛn nti na wode w’anim abutu fam seyie? 10
Israel ayɛ bɔne wɔato m’apam a mehyɛɛ wɔn ho mmara no nso na wɔafa ahyiradeɛ
Na Israelfoɔ no rentumi nnyina wɔn atamfoɔ anim
Sɔre te ɔman no ho na ka sɛ Monyɛ mo
Enti anɔpa wɔmfa mo mpinkyɛ mmusuakuo
Na deɛ wɔbɛkye no ahyiradeɛ
Ɛnna Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na ɔde Israel pinkyɛe abusuakuo abusuakuo. Na wɔkyeree Yuda abusuakuo.
Na ɔde Yuda mmusua pinkyɛe, na wɔkyeree Serafoɔ abusua.
Na ɔde ne fie mmarima pinkyɛe mmaako
Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Akan sɛ: Me ba, fa animuonyam ma AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, na di no ni, na ka kyerɛ me ɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woyɛeɛ? Nsi me so. 19
Na Akan buaa Yosua sɛ: Nokorɛ, me na mayɛ AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, bɔne, na sɛɛ ne sɛɛ na meyɛeɛ. 20
Mehunuu asadeɛ no mu Sinear ngusoɔ fɛfɛ bi ne dwetɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu
Ɛnna Yosua somaa abɔfoɔ na wɔde mmirika kɔɔ ntomadan no mu
Na wɔyi firii ntomadan no mu de brɛɛ Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no nyinaa, na wɔde bɛguu AWURADE anim. 23
Ɛnna Yosua faa Sera ba Akan ne dwetɛ
Na Yosua kaa sɛ: Adɛn na woaha yɛn saa yi? AWURADE bɛha wo nnɛ da yi.
Na wɔhɔree ne so abosie kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ yi.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ Nsuro na mma w’akoma nntu Fa akofoɔ dɔm no nyinaa
Na yɛ Ai ne
Na Yosua sɔree, ɔno ne akofoɔ dɔm no nyinaa sɛ wɔreforo akɔ Ai.
Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ Monhwɛ monkɔtɛ kuro no
Na me deɛ
na wɔbɛfiri adi abɛdi yɛn akyi akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwe wɔn afiri kuro no mu;
Na mo deɛ, monsɔre mfiri ɔtɛ no mu, na momfa kuro no, na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de bɛhyɛ mo nsa. 7
Na sɛ monya fa kuro no a monto
Ɛnna Yosua gyaa wɔn kwan, na wɔsii mu kɔe kɔtɛe. Na wɔtenaa Betel ne Ai ntam, Ai atɔeɛ fam; na Yosua daa ɔman no mu anadwo no.9
Na Yosua sɔree anɔpahema siesiee ɔman no, na ɔno ne Israel mpanimfoɔ foro dii ɔman no anim kɔɔ Ai. 10
Na akofoɔ dɔm a wɔka ne ho nyinaa foro kɔe na wɔtwe pinii
Na ɔde nnipa bɛyɛ mpemnum kɔtetɛɛ Betel ne Ai ntam, kuro no atɔeɛ fam. 12
Na wɔde dɔm no sisii ɛdɔm a wɔwɔ kuro
Na Ai hene hunuiɛ no ɔne ne man nyinaa kuro
Na Yosua ne Israel nyinaa maa wɔpamoo wɔn
Ɛnna wɔteaa mu frɛɛ ɔman a wɔwɔ kuro no
Na ɔbarima biara anka Ai ne Betel a wamfiri adi ankɔdi Israel akyire; na wɔgyaa kuro no hɔ maa ano daa hɔ kɔdii Israel akyi.17
Ɛnna AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Tene pea a ɛwɔ wo nsam no kyerɛ Ai, na mede bɛhyɛ wo nsa. Na Yosua tenee ne pea a ɛwɔ ne nsam no kyerɛɛ kuro no. 18
Ɛnna atɛfoɔ no sɔree ntɛm firii wɔn afa hɔ na ɔtenee ne nsa
Na Ai mmarima no danedanee wɔn ani hwɛɛ
Na Yosua ne Israel nyinaa hunuu sɛ atɛfoɔ no afa kuro
Na yeinom nso firii adi
Na Ai hene no wɔkyeree
Na Israel wiee Aifoɔ nyinaa kum wɔ ɛserɛ so petee mu faako a wɔbɛtii wɔn no na
Na nnipa a wɔtotɔɔ da no nyinaa, mmarima ne mmaa yɛ mpem dummienu, Aifoɔ nyinaa. 25
Na Yosua antwe ne nsa a ɔde tenee
Kuro no mu mmoa ne asadeɛ nko na Israel fom faeɛ, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔde hyɛɛ Yosua no teɛ no. 27
Na Yosua hyee Ai na ɔyɛɛ no daa amamfo sie de bɛsi nnɛ yi. 28
Na Ai hene no deɛ ɔsɛnee
Ɛnna Yosua kɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn Ebal bepɔ soɔ,
sɛdeɛ AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no
Na aboɔ no so hɔ na ɔtwerɛɛ Mose mmara ntimu a ɔtwerɛɛ no Israelfoɔ anim no. 32
Na Israel nyinaa ne wɔn mpanimfoɔ
Na ɛno akyiri no ɔkenkanee mmara mu nsɛm
Deɛ Mose hyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu asɛm biara nni hɔ a Yosua ankenkan
Na ahemfo a wɔwɔ Yordan agya ha fam mmepɔ so nyinaa ne Sefela mpaperɛ
wɔbɛhyia boaa wɔn ano yɛɛ nokorɔ sɛ wɔne Yosua ne Israel rebɛko.2

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 1
Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no mmara na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ Sɛ moduru Kanaan asase

na mo hyeɛ no mmra Akrabim aforoeɛ a

Na atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ no deɛ, ɛpo kɛseɛ a ɛda hɔ ma mo no na ɛnyɛ ɛhyeɛ; ɛno na ɛnyɛ mo atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ.6
Na yei nyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ: Momfiri po kɛseɛ no ano mfa mo ani nkari Hor bepɔ, 7

na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane nkɔduru Yordan,
Na Mose hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Yei ne asase a momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ mu nni soɔ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no. 13
Na Ruben mma abusuakuo sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ ne Gad

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 16
Mmarima a wɔnkyɛ asase no mu mma mo

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose wɔ Moab mpaperɛ so Yordan fa a ɛbɛn Yeriko no sɛ: 1
Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔmfa wɔn agyapadeɛ a wɔanya
Na nkuro no nyɛ wɔn tenabea na ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase
Na nkuro no ho mmoa adidibea nsase a mode bɛma Lewifoɔ
Na monsusu kuro no akyi apueeɛ fam basafa apem ne anafoɔ
Na nkuro a mode ma Lewifoɔ no nyɛ dwanekɔbea
Nkuro a mode bɛma Lewifoɔ no nyinaa nyɛ nkuro aduanan nwɔtwe ne ɛho mmoa adidibea nsase. 7
Na nkuro a mogye firi Israelfoɔ no agyapadeɛ mu ma Lewifoɔ
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 9
Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no na ka
monyiyi nkuro a ɛfata na ɛnyɛ dwanekɔbea
Na nkuro no nyɛ dwanekɔbea mma mo mfiri ɔweretɔfoɔ nsam na onipakumfoɔ
Na nkuro a mobɛyie no nyɛ mo dwanekɔbea nkuro nsia. 13
Monyi nkuro mmiɛnsa mma Yordan agya na monyi
ɛnyɛ dwanekɔbea nkuro na
Na sɛ obi de dadeɛ bɔ
Na sɛ obi kura ɔboɔ a ɛbɛtumi akum onipa na
Anaasɛ ɔkura dua a ɛbɛtumi akum onipa de bɔ obi ma no wu a, ɔyɛ owudini; kum na wɔnkum owudini no. 18
Mogya ho weretɔfoɔ na ɔnkum owudini no; ɔto no a, ɔnku no. 19
Na sɛ ɔtane so na ɔwɔɔ no, anaasɛ ɔboapa to biribi bɔ no ma no wu, 20
anaasɛ nitan so na ɔde ne nsa bɔ no ma
Na sɛ obi sum
anaasɛ wanhunu obi na ɔde ɔboɔ bi a ɛtumi kum onipa bɔ no ma no wu, na ɔnyɛ ne tamfo, nso ɔmpɛ no bɔne bi a, 23
ɛnneɛ asafo no nnyina saa ahyɛdeɛ yi so mmu onipakumfoɔ no ne mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no ntam atɛn. 24
Na asafo no nyi onipakumfoɔ
Na sɛ onipakumfoɔ no firi adi tra ne dwanekɔbea kuro a ɔdwane kɔɔ mu no hyeɛ so, 26
na mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no kɔto
Na anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtena ne dwanekɔbea kuro no mu kɔsi
Na yei nyɛ atemmuo ahyɛdeɛ mma mo
Obiara a ɔkum obi no adansefoɔ anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nkum onipakumfoɔ
Nso monnnye owudini a ɔdi fɔ sɛ wakum onipa bi no hɔ biribiara mmfa nnnye no nkwa; na mmom kum na wɔnku no. 31
Na monnnye agyedeɛ nso nnsi ne dwanekɔbea kuro mu dwanekorɔ ananmu mmma no nnsane mmmɛtena asase no so kɔsi sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no bɛwuo. 32
Na monnyɛ saa nngu asase a mote soɔ no ho fi ɛfiri sɛ mogya
Na monngu asase a mote soɔ na me nso mete mu no ho fi, na mene AWURADE a mete Israelfoɔ mu no.34
Na Gilead Makir ba Manase
na wɔse: AWURADE ahyɛ me wura sɛ wɔmfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ asase no mu mma Israelfoɔ
Na sɛ wɔkɔyɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu mma bi yerenom a ɛnneɛ wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛfiri yɛn nananom
na sɛ ɛduru Israelfoɔ ahosɛpɛ afahyɛ afe so a, wɔde wɔn agyapadeɛ no bɛka abusuakuo a wɔakɔyɛ wɔn dea no agyapadeɛ ho,
Na Mose nam AWURADE asɛm so hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Deɛ Yosef mma abusuakuo aka yi tene. 5
Yei ne deɛ AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ Selofehad mmammaa no ho Obiara a wɔsusu sɛ ɔyɛ
na Israelfoɔ agyapadeɛ amfiri abusuakuo bi mu ankɔ abusuakuo foforɔ bi mu,
Na ɔbabaa biara a ɔnya agyapadeɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo mu no nyɛ obi
na agyapadeɛ bi amfiri abusuakuo
Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no, saa ara na Selofehad mmammaa no yɛeɛ; 10
na Mahla Tirsa ne Hogla
na wɔwarewaree wɔn a wɔfiri Yosef ba Ma

na wɔmfa ntoma kɔkɔɔ nsɛ nnoɔma no so,

Na wɔmfa ɔsom nnoɔma a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ no nyinaa nhyɛ bibitoma mu, na wɔmfa sukraman nwoma nkatasoɔ nkata ho, na wɔmfa nto pata no so. 12

na wɔmfa ɛho nnoɔma a wɔde som so nyi

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose ne Aaron sɛ: 17
Momma wɔntwa Kohatfoɔ mmusua mu abusuakuo no mmfiri Lewifoɔ mu, na yei na monyɛ mma wɔn, 18
na wɔanya nkwa
na wɔn deɛ wɔnnhyɛne mu mmfa

Bu Gerson mma no nso ano, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie ne wɔn mmusua teɛ; 22

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 1
Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no na wɔntu akwatafoɔ nyinaa ne wɔn a
Ɔbarima ne ɔbaa na montu no nsraban
Israelfoɔ no yɛɛ saa na wɔtuu wɔn kɔɔ nsraban
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 5
Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa yɛ bɔne tia onipa bi de fom AWURADE a,
ɔmpae mu nka wɔn bɔne a wɔayɛ no na ɔntua n’asodideɛ
Na sɛ onipa no awu na ɔnni busuani a ɔbɛn
Na mmasoɔ adeɛ biara Israelfoɔ no akronkronneɛ a wɔde brɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no nyinaa, nyɛ ne deɛ.
Na obiara akronkronneɛ yɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no dea deɛ
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 11
Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka
na ɔbarima bi ne no da
na ninkuntwe honhom ba ɔbarima no so
ɛnneɛ ɔbarima no mfa ne yere
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ɔbaa
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nsa nsu kronkron ngu kukuo bi mu, na ɔnsa tenabea hɔ fam mfuturo bi, na ɔmfa ngu nsuo no mu;
na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ɔbaa no nnyi
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mma
na sɛ woafiri wo kunu akyi,
ɛno deɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no mma ɔbaa
na nsuo a ɛde nnome ba yi ahyɛne wo nsono mu ahonhon wo yafunu
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no ntwerɛ nnome yi ngu nwoma so, na ɔnhohoro ngu nsu nwononwono no mu, 23
na ɔmma ɔbaa no nnom nsu nwononwono a ɛde nnome ba no,
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nnye ɔbaa
na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa aduane afɔdeɛ
Na sɛ ɔma no nom a na
Na sɛ ɔbaa no ho nguu fi na ne

anaasɛ ninkuntwe honhom ba ɔbarima bi so na ɔtwe ne yere ho ninkunu a, ɔmfa ɔbaa no mmɛgyina AWURADE anim, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nyɛ no sɛdeɛ mmara yi hyɛ nyinaa. 30

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 1
Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi de ne ho kɔhyɛ ahotuafoɔ mu hyɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛtua ne ho adeɛ de ne ho ama AWURADE a,
ɛnneɛ ɔntua ne ho bobesa
n’ahotua nna nyinaa mu, biribiara a wɔde bobe ho biribi ayɛ, ne nsoeɛ mu aba oo, ne hono oo, ɔnnni.4
N’ahotua bɔhyɛ nna nyinaa mu no yiwan biara nnka ne ti; ɔnyɛ kronkron nkɔsi sɛ nna a ɔtuaa ne ho maa AWURADE no bɛwie duro; ɔnsi atimum.
Nna a watua ne ho adeɛ ama AWURADE no, ɔnnkɔ efunu ho. 6
N’agya ne
N’ahotua nna nyinaa ɔyɛ kronkron ma AWURADE.8
Na sɛ obi kɔwu mpofirim wɔ ne nkyɛn ma ɔgu n’ahotua tiri ho fi a, ɔnyi ne tiri n’ahodwira da a ɛne da a ɛtɔ so nson no mu.
Na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano.
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ na
Na ɔntua ne ho adeɛ mma AWURADE n’ahotua nna no, na ɔmfa odwanten ba a wadi afe mmra mmɛbɔ asodie ho afɔdeɛ; na kane nna no ayera, ɛfiri sɛ n’ahotua no ho agu fi.12
Na yei ne ahotuafoɔ ho mmara: Ɛda a n’ahotua nna wie duro no, wɔmfa no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano, 13
na ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE odwanten ba a wadi afe
ne apiti paanoo, esiam taterɛ a wɔde ngo afɔre,

Na ɔhotuafoɔ no nyi n’ahotua ti ahyiaeɛ ntomadan
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa odwennini
na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhim
Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔhotuafoɔ

Gye no wɔn nsam na wɔmfa nyɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan

nantwinini baako odwennini
ɔpapo baako a wɔde rekɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ; 22

Nyankopɔn abufuo sɔre tiaa wɔn,31

Na ɔkaee sɛ wɔyɛ ɔhonam,39

Mprɛ ahe ara na wɔante n’anim atua ɛserɛ soɔ,40

Na wɔsane sɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe,41

Wɔankae ne tumi,42

Ɔdanee wɔn nsubɔntene mogya,44

Ɔsomaa ahuriiɛ bɛguu wɔn so maa wɔbɛwee wɔn,45

Ɔde wɔn nnɔbaeɛ maa mmɛbɛ,46

Ɔde asukɔtweaa sɛee wɔn bobe,47
na ɔde nsukyenkyeneeɛ bɔɔ wɔn akyee nnua,

ne wɔn mmoakuo maa asraman.
Ɔtoo n’abufuo hyehyeɛ no guu wɔn so,49

Ɔbɔɔ kwan maa n’abufuo,50

Na ɔkumm Misraim mmakan nyinaa,51

Na ɔgyaa ne man sɛ nnwan,52

Na ɔde wɔn baa ne kronkronbea hyeɛ so,54

Wɔde wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea huruu ne bo,58

Na AWURADE nyanee sɛ obi a ɔfiri nna mu,65
